Recommended (=)

english: Two hours before a domestic departure and three hours before an international one. Add an hour if you are checking sports equipment, travelling with an unaccompanied minor, or need a document check.
amharic: ከአገር ውስጥ መነሻ ሁለት ሰዓት በፊት፤ ከዓለም አቀፍ ደግሞ ሦስት ሰዓት በፊት። የስፖርት መሣሪያ የሚመዘግቡ ከሆነ፣ ከያለአጃቢ ሕፃን ጋር የሚጓዙ ከሆነ፣ ወይም የሰነድ ፍተሻ የሚያስፈልግዎት ከሆነ አንድ ሰዓት ይጨምሩ።
back_translation: Two hours before a domestic departure; three hours before an international one. Add an hour if you are checking sports equipment, if you travel with an unaccompanied child, or if you need a document check.
The deadlines (=)

english: Check-in closes 2 hours before departure, online and at the desk alike.
amharic: ቼክ-ኢን ከመነሻው 2 ሰዓት በፊት ይዘጋል፤ በመስመር ላይም ሆነ በጠረጴዛው።
back_translation: Check-in closes 2 hours before departure, online and at the desk alike. (=)

english: Bag drop closes 60 minutes before departure.
amharic: የሻንጣ ማስረከቢያ ከመነሻው 60 ደቂቃ በፊት ይዘጋል።
back_translation: Bag drop closes 60 minutes before departure. (=)

english: The gate closes 20 minutes before departure, and a boarding pass does not hold it open.
amharic: በሩ ከመነሻው 20 ደቂቃ በፊት ይዘጋል፤ የመሳፈሪያ ፈቃድም ክፍት አያደርገውም።
back_translation: The gate closes 20 minutes before departure, and a boarding pass does not hold it open. (=)

english: Recommended times, and the three deadlines that actually bind.
amharic: የሚመከሩ ጊዜያት፣ እና በእውነት የሚያስገድዱት ሦስት የጊዜ ገደቦች።
back_translation: Recommended times, and the three deadlines that actually bind. (=)

english: When to arrive at the airport
amharic: ወደ አየር ማረፊያ መቼ መድረስ እንዳለብዎ
back_translation: When to arrive at the airport (=)
Desk hours

english: Desks open 3 hours before an international departure and 2 hours before a domestic one, and close 60 minutes before departure on all routes. Bag drop for passengers already checked in online closes at the same time.
amharic: ጠረጴዛዎች ከዓለም አቀፍ መነሻ 3 ሰዓት በፊት እና ከአገር ውስጥ 2 ሰዓት በፊት ይከፈታሉ፤ በሁሉም መስመሮች ከመነሻው 60 ደቂቃ በፊት ይዘጋሉ። አስቀድመው በመስመር ላይ ቼክ-ኢን ላደረጉ ተሳፋሪዎች የሻንጣ ማስረከቢያም በተመሳሳይ ሰዓት ይዘጋል።
back_translation: Desks open 3 hours before an international departure and 2 hours before a domestic one; on all routes they close 60 minutes before departure. For passengers who have already checked in online, baggage drop-off also closes at the same hour.
When a desk is required

english: Passengers travelling with an infant on the lap, an unaccompanied minor, booked special assistance, or on a partner-operated sector must check in at a desk. Group bookings of ten or more are handled by the group desk.
amharic: ጨቅላን በጭን ይዘው የሚጓዙ፣ ያለአጃቢ ሕፃናት፣ ልዩ ድጋፍ ያስያዙ፣ ወይም በአጋር በሚከናወን ክፍል ላይ ያሉ ተሳፋሪዎች በጠረጴዛ ቼክ-ኢን ማድረግ አለባቸው። አሥርና ከዚያ በላይ የቡድን ቦታ ማስያዣዎች በቡድን ጠረጴዛ ይስተናገዳሉ።
back_translation: Passengers travelling with an infant on the lap, children without an escort, those who have booked special assistance, or those on a partner-operated sector, must check in at a desk. Group bookings of ten and above are handled at the group desk.

english: Desk opening and closing times, and when you must use a desk.
amharic: የጠረጴዛ መክፈቻና መዝጊያ ሰዓቶች፣ እና ጠረጴዛ መጠቀም ያለብዎት መቼ እንደሆነ።
back_translation: Desk opening and closing hours, and when you must use a desk.
Airport check-in and baggage drop-off
Complimentary (=)

english: Water, tea, coffee and soft drinks on every flight. Beer and wine with a meal on flights over three hours. A full bar in Highland Class.
amharic: በእያንዳንዱ በረራ ውሃ፣ ሻይ፣ ቡናና ለስላሳ መጠጦች። ከሦስት ሰዓት በላይ በሚደረጉ በረራዎች ከምግብ ጋር ቢራና ወይን። በሃይላንድ ክላስ ደግሞ ሙሉ መጠጥ ቤት።
back_translation: Water, tea, coffee and soft drinks on every flight. Beer and wine with a meal on flights over three hours. A full bar in Highland Class. (=)
Limits (=)

english: Cabin crew serve alcohol at their discretion and will stop serving a passenger who has had enough. You may not drink your own alcohol on board, including duty free. Both rules are safety requirements, not house policy.
amharic: የካቢን ሠራተኞች አልኮል የሚያቀርቡት በራሳቸው ውሳኔ ነው፤ በቂ ለጠጣ ተሳፋሪም ማቅረብ ያቆማሉ። ከቀረጥ ነጻ የተገዛውን ጨምሮ የራስዎን አልኮል በበረራ ላይ መጠጣት አይችሉም። ሁለቱም ደንቦች የቤት ውስጥ ፖሊሲ ሳይሆኑ የደህንነት መስፈርቶች ናቸው።
back_translation: Cabin crew serve alcohol at their discretion and will stop serving a passenger who has had enough. You may not drink your own alcohol on board, including duty free. Both rules are safety requirements, not house policy. (=)

english: What is complimentary, and the limits on alcohol.
amharic: በነጻ የሚቀርበው፣ እና በአልኮል ላይ ያሉ ገደቦች።
back_translation: What is complimentary, and the limits on alcohol. (=)
Drinks on board (=)

english: We cannot guarantee an allergen-free cabin
back_translation: We cannot give a guarantee of an allergen-free cabin

english: Our aircraft are not free of nuts, dairy, gluten, sesame or shellfish. Other passengers may bring food on board, and cabins are not deep-cleaned between every sector. We therefore cannot describe any flight as allergen-free.
amharic: አውሮፕላኖቻችን ከለውዝ፣ ከወተት ተዋጽኦ፣ ከግሉተን፣ ከሰሊጥ ወይም ከሼልፊሽ ነጻ አይደሉም። ሌሎች ተሳፋሪዎች ምግብ ይዘው ሊገቡ ይችላሉ፤ ካቢኖችም በእያንዳንዱ ክፍል መካከል በጥልቀት አይጸዱም። ስለዚህ ማንኛውንም በረራ አለርጂ-ነጻ ብለን መግለጽ አንችልም።
back_translation: Our aircraft are not free of nuts, dairy products, gluten, sesame or shellfish. Other passengers may bring food aboard; cabins are also not deeply cleaned between each sector. Therefore we cannot describe any flight as allergen-free.
Before you travel

english: Tell us at least 48 hours before departure by adding a note to your booking or calling the contact office for your country.
amharic: ከመነሻው ቢያንስ 48 ሰዓት በፊት በቦታ ማስያዣዎ ላይ ማስታወሻ በመጨመር ወይም የአገርዎን የመገናኛ ቢሮ በመደወል ያሳውቁን።
back_translation: Tell us at least 48 hours before departure by adding a note to your booking or by telephoning your country's contact office.

english: Order a special meal that excludes your allergen. Special meals close 24 hours before departure and cannot be arranged at the airport.
amharic: አለርጂዎን የማያካትት ልዩ ምግብ ያዙ። ልዩ ምግቦች ከመነሻው 24 ሰዓት በፊት ይዘጋሉ፤ በአየር ማረፊያም ሊዘጋጁ አይችሉም።
back_translation: Order a special meal that does not include your allergen. Special meals close 24 hours before departure; they also cannot be prepared at the airport.

english: Carry your own antihistamines and adrenaline auto-injector in your cabin baggage, not in the hold. Cabin crew carry a medical kit but it is not a substitute for your own medication.
amharic: የራስዎን ፀረ-ሂስታሚንና የአድሬናሊን መርፌ በእጅ ሻንጣዎ ውስጥ ይያዙ፤ በጭነት ክፍል ውስጥ አይደለም። የካቢን ሠራተኞች የሕክምና ቁሳቁስ ይይዛሉ፤ ነገር ግን ለራስዎ መድኃኒት ምትክ አይደለም።
back_translation: Carry your own antihistamine and adrenaline injector in your hand baggage, not in the hold. Cabin crew carry medical equipment, but it is not a substitute for your own medicine.

english: Bring a doctor's letter if you carry injectable medication, so it is not questioned at security.
amharic: የመርፌ መድኃኒት የሚይዙ ከሆነ በደህንነት ፍተሻ ጥያቄ እንዳይነሳ የሐኪም ደብዳቤ ይዘው ይምጡ።
back_translation: If you carry injectable medicine, bring a doctor's letter so that no question arises at the security check.
On the flight

english: Tell the cabin crew when you board. They can make an announcement asking other passengers not to open nut products, and they will note your seat. The announcement is a request, not an enforceable rule.
amharic: በሚሳፈሩበት ጊዜ ለካቢን ሠራተኞች ይንገሩ። ሌሎች ተሳፋሪዎች የለውዝ ምርቶችን እንዳይከፍቱ ማስታወቂያ ማድረግ ይችላሉ፤ መቀመጫዎንም ይመዘግባሉ። ማስታወቂያው ጥያቄ እንጂ የሚያስገድድ ደንብ አይደለም።
back_translation: Tell the cabin crew when you board. They can make an announcement asking other passengers not to open nut products; they will also record your seat. The announcement is a request, not an enforceable rule.

english: You may bring your own sealed food on board for your own consumption.
amharic: ለራስዎ ፍጆታ የታሸገ የራስዎን ምግብ ይዘው መሳፈር ይችላሉ።
back_translation: You may board carrying your own sealed food for your own consumption.
Buffer zones

english: On request we will seat you away from the galley and note a buffer of one row in front and behind. Buffer zones cannot be guaranteed on a full flight.
amharic: በጥያቄዎ መሠረት ከጋሊው ራቅ ብለን እናስቀምጥዎታለን፤ ከፊትና ከኋላ የአንድ ረድፍ መከላከያም እንመዘግባለን። በሙሉ በረራ ላይ የመከላከያ ቀጠናዎች ዋስትና ሊሰጣቸው አይችልም።
back_translation: On your request we will seat you away from the galley; we will also record a buffer of one row in front and behind. On a full flight buffer zones cannot be guaranteed.

english: What we can and cannot do for passengers with food allergies.
amharic: የምግብ አለርጂ ላላቸው ተሳፋሪዎች ምን ማድረግ እንደምንችልና እንደማንችል።
back_translation: What we can and cannot do for passengers with a food allergy.
Allergies on the flight
Codes

english: WCHR means assistance to the aircraft door with the passenger able to climb steps; WCHS means unable to climb steps; WCHC means immobile throughout and requiring assistance to the seat. Request at least 48 hours ahead.
amharic: WCHR ማለት ተሳፋሪው ደረጃ መውጣት ሲችል እስከ አውሮፕላኑ በር ድረስ ድጋፍ ማለት ነው፤ WCHS ደረጃ መውጣት አለመቻል ማለት ነው፤ WCHC ደግሞ በሙሉ መንቀሳቀስ አለመቻልና እስከ መቀመጫው ድረስ ድጋፍ ማስፈለግ ማለት ነው። ቢያንስ ከ48 ሰዓት በፊት ይጠይቁ።
back_translation: WCHR means assistance as far as the aircraft door when the passenger can climb steps; WCHS means being unable to climb steps; WCHC means being wholly unable to move and needing assistance as far as the seat. Request at least 48 hours ahead.

english: A booking with assistance recorded cannot be checked in online; a desk agent must confirm the arrangements in person.
amharic: ድጋፍ የተመዘገበበት የቦታ ማስያዣ በመስመር ላይ ቼክ-ኢን ሊደረግ አይችልም፤ የጠረጴዛ ወኪል ዝግጅቱን በአካል ማረጋገጥ አለበት።
back_translation: A booking on which assistance is recorded cannot be checked in online; a desk agent must confirm the arrangement in person.

english: Wheelchair codes, and how a request changes your check-in.
amharic: የተሽከርካሪ ወንበር ኮዶች፣ እና ጥያቄ ቼክ-ኢንዎን እንዴት እንደሚቀይር።
back_translation: Wheelchair codes, and how a request changes your check-in.
Mobility assistance

english: The first marketing carrier sets the allowance
amharic: የመጀመሪያው ሻጭ አየር መንገድ ፈቃዱን ይወስናል
back_translation: The first selling airline determines the allowance

english: Where a journey booked with us includes a sector operated by a partner, our allowance applies throughout, provided the whole journey is on one booking reference. Separate bookings are treated as separate journeys and each carrier's own rules apply.
amharic: ከእኛ ጋር የተያዘ ጉዞ በአጋር የሚከናወን ክፍል ካካተተ፣ ጉዞው በሙሉ በአንድ የቦታ ማስያዣ ማጣቀሻ እስከሆነ ድረስ የእኛ ፈቃድ በሙሉ ጉዞው ላይ ይሠራል። የተለያዩ የቦታ ማስያዣዎች እንደ የተለያዩ ጉዞዎች ይቆጠራሉ፤ የእያንዳንዱም አየር መንገድ ደንብ ይሠራል።
back_translation: If a journey held with us includes a sector operated by a partner, our allowance applies to the whole journey as long as the journey is on one booking reference. Separate bookings count as separate journeys; each airline's own rule applies.

english: Partner-operated sectors cannot be checked in online; use the airport desk.
amharic: በአጋር የሚከናወኑ ክፍሎች በመስመር ላይ ቼክ-ኢን ሊደረጉ አይችሉም፤ የአየር ማረፊያውን ጠረጴዛ ይጠቀሙ።
back_translation: Partner-operated sectors cannot be checked in online; use the airport desk.

english: Whose rules apply when part of your journey is flown by another airline.
amharic: የጉዞዎ አንድ ክፍል በሌላ አየር መንገድ ሲከናወን የማን ደንብ እንደሚሠራ።
back_translation: Whose rule applies when one part of your journey is operated by another airline.
Baggage on partner-operated flights
Infants under two years

english: An infant travelling on an adult's lap has one checked bag of up to 10 kg and no cabin baggage allowance of their own.
amharic: በአዋቂ ጭን ላይ የሚጓዝ ጨቅላ እስከ 10 ኪግ የሚመዝን አንድ የተመዘገበ ሻንጣ አለው፤ የራሱ የእጅ ሻንጣ ፈቃድ የለውም።
back_translation: An infant travelling on an adult's lap has one registered bag weighing up to 10 kg; it has no hand baggage allowance of its own.

english: One pushchair and one car seat travel free on every route, in addition to the allowance, and may be taken to the aircraft door.
amharic: አንድ የሕፃን ጋሪና አንድ የመኪና መቀመጫ ከፈቃዱ በተጨማሪ በሁሉም መስመር በነጻ ይጓዛሉ፤ እስከ አውሮፕላኑ በር ሊወሰዱም ይችላሉ።
back_translation: One pushchair and one car seat travel free on every route in addition to the allowance; they may also be taken as far as the aircraft door.

amharic: ከሁለት እስከ አስራ አንድ ዓመት ሕፃናት
back_translation: Children from two to eleven years

english: A child with their own seat has the same free allowance as an adult on the same route and cabin.
amharic: የራሱ መቀመጫ ያለው ሕፃን በተመሳሳይ መስመርና የጉዞ ክፍል ከአዋቂ ጋር እኩል የነጻ ፈቃድ አለው።
back_translation: A child with its own seat has a free allowance equal to an adult's on the same route and cabin class.

english: Allowances for passengers under 12, and what counts as equipment.
amharic: ከ12 ዓመት በታች ላሉ ተሳፋሪዎች ፈቃዶች፣ እና እንደ መሣሪያ የሚቆጠረው።
back_translation: Allowances for passengers under 12, and what counts as equipment.
Baggage for infants and children
Through-checked (=)

english: On a single booking your bag is tagged to your final destination and you do not see it in between, whichever airlines operate the legs.
amharic: በአንድ የቦታ ማስያዣ ላይ ሻንጣዎ እስከ መጨረሻ መድረሻዎ ይመዘገባል፤ ክፍሎቹን የትኛውም አየር መንገድ ቢያከናውን በመሃል አያዩትም።
back_translation: On a single booking your bag is registered through to your final destination and you do not see it in between, whichever airline operates the sections.

english: When you must collect and recheck
back_translation: When you must collect and recheck (=)

english: Two separate bookings, even on the same airline and the same day.
amharic: ሁለት የተለያዩ የቦታ ማስያዣዎች፤ በተመሳሳይ አየር መንገድና በተመሳሳይ ቀን ቢሆኑም እንኳ።
back_translation: Two separate bookings, even on the same airline and the same day. (=)

english: A country that requires every arriving bag to clear customs, whatever your onward plan.
amharic: ቀጣይ ዕቅድዎ ምንም ይሁን ምን የሚደርስ እያንዳንዱ ሻንጣ ጉምሩክ እንዲያልፍ የምትጠይቅ አገር።
back_translation: A country that requires every arriving bag to clear customs, whatever your onward plan. (=)

english: A change of terminal where the two are not connected airside.
amharic: ሁለቱ ከደህንነት ፍተሻ በኋላ ባልተገናኙበት የተርሚናል ለውጥ።
back_translation: A change of terminal where the two are not connected past the security check.
Minimum connection time (=)

english: We do not sell a connection shorter than the minimum for that airport, so a legal connection is long enough for the bag as well. If the first flight is late and the bag misses the second, it follows on the next service and we deliver it.
amharic: ለዚያ አየር ማረፊያ ካለው አነስተኛ ጊዜ የሚያጥር መሸጋገሪያ አንሸጥም፤ ስለዚህ ሕጋዊ መሸጋገሪያ ለሻንጣውም በቂ ነው። የመጀመሪያው በረራ ከዘገየና ሻንጣው ሁለተኛውን ካመለጠ በሚቀጥለው በረራ ይከተላል፤ እኛም እናደርስልዎታለን።
back_translation: We do not sell a connection shorter than the minimum for that airport, so a legal connection is long enough for the bag as well. If the first flight is late and the bag misses the second, it follows on the next service and we deliver it. (=)

english: When a bag is through-checked, and when you must collect it.
amharic: ሻንጣ መቼ እስከመጨረሻው እንደሚመዘገብ፣ እና መቼ መውሰድ እንዳለብዎ።
back_translation: When a bag is through-checked, and when you must collect it. (=)
Bags on a connection (=)
Never permitted
Explosives, fireworks and flares.

english: Compressed gases, including camping gas and unapproved oxygen cylinders.
amharic: የተጨመቁ ጋዞች፣ የካምፕ ጋዝንና ያልጸደቁ የኦክስጅን ሲሊንደሮችን ጨምሮ።
back_translation: Compressed gases, including camping gas and unapproved oxygen cylinders.

english: Corrosives such as mercury, wet-cell batteries and drain cleaner.
amharic: እንደ ሜርኩሪ፣ እርጥብ ባትሪዎችና የቱቦ ማጽጃ ያሉ የሚበሉ ንጥረ ነገሮች።
back_translation: Corrosive substances such as mercury, wet batteries and drain cleaner.
In the hold only

english: Sharp articles, tools longer than 6 cm, sporting bats and cricket stumps must be checked. Spare lithium batteries are the reverse: they must travel in the cabin and never in the hold.
amharic: ስለታም ዕቃዎች፣ ከ6 ሴሜ የሚረዝሙ መሣሪያዎች፣ የስፖርት ዱላዎችና የክሪኬት እንጨቶች መመዝገብ አለባቸው። ተጠባባቂ የሊቲየም ባትሪዎች ግን ተቃራኒ ናቸው፤ በካቢን ውስጥ መጓዝ አለባቸው እንጂ በጭነት ክፍል በፍጹም አይደለም።
back_translation: Sharp items, tools longer than 6 cm, sports bats and cricket stumps must be registered. Spare lithium batteries, however, are the opposite: they must travel in the cabin and never in the hold.

english: What may not travel at all, and what may travel only in the hold.
amharic: በፍጹም መጓዝ የማይችለው፣ እና በጭነት ክፍል ብቻ መጓዝ የሚችለው።
back_translation: What may not travel at all, and what may travel only in the hold.
Restricted and prohibited items
Times

english: Boarding begins 40 minutes before departure and the gate closes 20 minutes before. A boarding pass shows the boarding time, not the departure time, in its boarding field.
amharic: መሳፈር ከመነሻው 40 ደቂቃ በፊት ይጀምራል፤ በሩም 20 ደቂቃ በፊት ይዘጋል። የመሳፈሪያ ፈቃድ በመሳፈሪያ ሳጥኑ ውስጥ የመሳፈሪያ ሰዓቱን እንጂ የመነሻ ሰዓቱን አያሳይም።
back_translation: Boarding begins 40 minutes before departure; the gate also closes 20 minutes before. In its boarding box, the boarding pass shows the boarding time and not the departure time.

english: Passengers not at the gate at closure are offloaded with their baggage and the fare rules of their ticket determine whether a rebooking is chargeable.
amharic: በመዘጋቻ ሰዓት በበሩ ያልተገኙ ተሳፋሪዎች ከሻንጣቸው ጋር ይወርዳሉ፤ የትኬታቸው የታሪፍ ደንቦችም እንደገና ማስያዝ የሚያስከፍል መሆኑን ይወስናሉ።
back_translation: Passengers not found at the gate at closing time are offloaded together with their baggage; the fare rules of their ticket determine whether rebooking is chargeable.

english: When boarding starts, and what happens if you arrive late at the gate.
amharic: መሳፈር መቼ እንደሚጀምር፣ እና በበሩ ዘግይተው ከደረሱ ምን እንደሚሆን።
back_translation: When boarding begins, and what happens if you arrive late at the gate.
Boarding and gate closure

english: Passenger details and contact details are different
amharic: የተሳፋሪ መረጃና የመገናኛ መረጃ የተለያዩ ናቸው
back_translation: Passenger details and contact details are different (=)

english: Passenger names must match each traveller's passport exactly. The contact email and telephone can be yours, and that is where every notice about the flight is sent.
amharic: የተሳፋሪ ስሞች ከእያንዳንዱ ተጓዥ ፓስፖርት ጋር በትክክል መዛመድ አለባቸው። የመገናኛ ኢሜይልና ስልክ ግን የእርስዎ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ፤ ስለ በረራው የሚሰጠው እያንዳንዱ ማሳወቂያም ወደዚያ ይላካል።
back_translation: Passenger names must match each traveller's passport exactly. The contact email and telephone can be yours, and that is where every notice about the flight is sent. (=)
Who can manage it afterwards (=)

english: Anyone holding the booking reference and the lead passenger's surname. There is no password on a booking, so treat the reference as you would a ticket.
amharic: የቦታ ማስያዣ ማጣቀሻውንና የዋናውን ተሳፋሪ የአያት ስም የያዘ ማንኛውም ሰው። በቦታ ማስያዣ ላይ የይለፍ ቃል የለም፤ ስለዚህ ማጣቀሻውን እንደ ትኬት ይያዙት።
back_translation: Anyone holding the booking reference and the lead passenger's surname. There is no password on a booking, so treat the reference as you would a ticket. (=)

english: Whose details go where, and who can then manage the booking.
amharic: የማን መረጃ የት እንደሚገባ፣ እና ከዚያ በኋላ የቦታ ማስያዣውን ማን ማስተዳደር እንደሚችል።
back_translation: Whose details go where, and who can then manage the booking. (=)
Booking for someone else (=)

english: What you may carry into the cabin
back_translation: What you may carry into the cabin

english: One cabin bag of up to 7 kg in Selam Economy and 14 kg in Highland Class, not exceeding 55 x 38 x 20 cm including wheels and handles. One personal item such as a handbag or laptop bag may be carried in addition.
amharic: በሰላም ኢኮኖሚ እስከ 7 ኪግ እና በሃይላንድ ክላስ እስከ 14 ኪግ የሚመዝን አንድ የእጅ ሻንጣ፤ መንኮራኩሮችንና እጀታዎችን ጨምሮ ከ55 x 38 x 20 ሴሜ መብለጥ የለበትም። እንደ የእጅ ቦርሳ ወይም የላፕቶፕ ቦርሳ ያለ አንድ የግል ዕቃ በተጨማሪ ሊያዝ ይችላል።
back_translation: One hand bag weighing up to 7 kg in Selam Economy and up to 14 kg in Highland Class; including wheels and handles it must not exceed 55 x 38 x 20 cm. One personal item such as a handbag or a laptop bag may be carried in addition.

english: On full flights and on Dash 8-400 services, cabin bags may be placed in the hold at the gate at no charge. Remove medication, documents and valuables first.
amharic: በሙሉ በረራዎችና በዳሽ 8-400 አገልግሎቶች የእጅ ሻንጣዎች ያለክፍያ በበሩ ላይ ወደ ጭነት ክፍል ሊገቡ ይችላሉ። መድኃኒት፣ ሰነዶችንና ውድ ዕቃዎችን አስቀድመው ያውጡ።
back_translation: On full flights and on Dash 8-400 services, hand bags may go into the hold at the gate without charge. Take out medicine, documents and valuables first.
Liquids

english: Containers of up to 100 ml each, in a single transparent resealable bag of no more than one litre. Baby food and prescribed medication for the journey are exempt but must be declared at security.
amharic: እያንዳንዳቸው እስከ 100 ሚሊ ሊትር የሆኑ ዕቃዎች፣ ከአንድ ሊትር በማይበልጥ አንድ ግልጽ ሊዘጋ በሚችል ከረጢት ውስጥ። የሕፃናት ምግብና ለጉዞው የታዘዘ መድኃኒት ነጻ ናቸው፤ ነገር ግን በደህንነት ፍተሻ መገለጽ አለባቸው።
back_translation: Items of up to 100 millilitres each, inside one transparent resealable bag of no more than one litre. Baby food and medicine prescribed for the journey are free, but they must be declared at the security check.

english: Size, weight and what must go in the hold instead.
amharic: መጠን፣ ክብደትና በምትኩ በጭነት ክፍል መሄድ ያለበት።
back_translation: Size, weight, and what must go in the hold instead.
Hand baggage
Why the cabin feels dry (=)

english: Cabin air is pressurised to about 2,400 metres and its humidity sits near 15 per cent, well below a room on the ground. That is why skin, eyes and throat feel dry and why alcohol has a stronger effect than it does on the ground.
amharic: የካቢን አየር ወደ 2,400 ሜትር ገደማ ግፊት ይደረግበታል፤ እርጥበቱም ከመሬት ላይ ካለ ክፍል በጣም ያነሰ ወደ 15 በመቶ ገደማ ነው። ቆዳ፣ ዓይንና ጉሮሮ ደረቅ የሚሰማቸው፣ አልኮልም ከመሬት ላይ በበለጠ የሚሠራው ለዚህ ነው።
back_translation: Cabin air is pressurised to around 2,400 metres and its humidity is around 15 per cent, far below a room on the ground. That is why skin, eyes and throat feel dry, and why alcohol acts more strongly than it does on the ground.
Circulation (=)

english: Sitting still for hours slows blood flow in the legs. Walk the cabin roughly every two hours when the seatbelt sign is off, flex your ankles in the seat, and keep drinking water. If you have had recent surgery, a clotting disorder or a previous thrombosis, ask your doctor about compression stockings before you fly.
amharic: ለሰዓታት ሳይንቀሳቀሱ መቀመጥ በእግሮች ውስጥ ያለውን የደም ፍሰት ያዘገየዋል። የመቀመጫ ቀበቶ ምልክቱ ሲጠፋ በየሁለት ሰዓቱ ገደማ በካቢኑ ውስጥ ይራመዱ፤ በመቀመጫዎ ላይ ሆነው ቁርጭምጭሚትዎን ያንቀሳቅሱ፤ ውሃም መጠጣትዎን ይቀጥሉ። በቅርቡ ቀዶ ጥገና ካደረጉ፣ የደም መርጋት ችግር ካለብዎ ወይም ቀደም ሲል የደም መርጋት ካጋጠምዎ ከመብረርዎ በፊት ስለ መጭመቂያ ካልሲዎች ሐኪምዎን ይጠይቁ።
back_translation: Sitting without moving for hours slows the blood flow in the legs. Walk in the cabin about every two hours when the seatbelt sign is off, move your ankles while seated, and keep drinking water. If you have had recent surgery, a blood-clotting problem, or a blood clot before, ask your doctor about compression stockings before you fly. [thrombosis is rendered as 'blood clotting']

amharic: የካቢን ከፍታ፣ የውሃ እጥረትና የደም ዝውውር።
back_translation: Cabin altitude, dehydration and circulation. (=)

english: Staying comfortable on a long flight
back_translation: Staying comfortable on a long flight (=)

english: They are not the same thing
back_translation: They are not the same thing (=)

english: Cancelling releases your seats. Refunding returns money. Cancelling does not trigger a refund, and on a non-refundable fare it returns nothing at all -- so cancel only after you have seen what the refund rules give you.
amharic: መሰረዝ መቀመጫዎችዎን ይለቃል። ተመላሽ ማድረግ ገንዘብ ይመልሳል። መሰረዝ ተመላሽ ክፍያን አያስከትልም፤ ተመላሽ በማይደረግ ታሪፍ ላይም ምንም አይመልስም። ስለዚህ የተመላሽ ክፍያ ደንቦች የሚሰጡዎትን ካዩ በኋላ ብቻ ይሰርዙ።
back_translation: Cancelling releases your seats. Refunding returns money. Cancelling does not trigger a refund, and on a non-refundable fare it returns nothing at all -- so cancel only after you have seen what the refund rules give you. (=)
What each fare returns (=)

english: Flex fares refund in full, less a processing fee.
amharic: የፍሌክስ ታሪፎች የማስኬጃ ክፍያ ተቀንሶ ሙሉ በሙሉ ተመላሽ ይደረጋሉ።
back_translation: Flex fares refund in full, less a processing fee. (=)

english: Standard fares refund a percentage, set by the fare rules on your booking.
amharic: የስታንዳርድ ታሪፎች በቦታ ማስያዣዎ ላይ ባሉት የታሪፍ ደንቦች በተወሰነ መቶኛ ተመላሽ ይደረጋሉ።
back_translation: Standard fares refund a percentage, set by the fare rules on your booking. (=)

english: Saver and promotional fares refund the government taxes only. The base fare is not returned.
amharic: የሴቨርና የቅናሽ ታሪፎች የመንግሥት ግብሮችን ብቻ ተመላሽ ያደርጋሉ። መሠረታዊው ታሪፍ አይመለስም።
back_translation: Saver and promotional fares refund the government taxes only. The base fare is not returned. (=)
How long it takes (=)

english: Approved refunds reach the original payment method in 7 to 21 working days. Bookings made through an agent are refunded to the agent, not to you.
amharic: የተፈቀዱ ተመላሽ ክፍያዎች በ7 እስከ 21 የሥራ ቀናት ውስጥ ወደ መጀመሪያው የክፍያ መንገድ ይደርሳሉ። በወኪል የተያዙ የቦታ ማስያዣዎች ተመላሽ የሚደረጉት ለወኪሉ እንጂ ለእርስዎ አይደለም።
back_translation: Approved refunds reach the original payment method within 7 to 21 working days. Bookings made through an agent are refunded to the agent, not to you.

english: Cancelling and refunding are two decisions, not one.
amharic: መሰረዝና ተመላሽ ማድረግ ሁለት ውሳኔዎች እንጂ አንድ አይደሉም።
back_translation: Cancelling and refunding are two decisions, not one. (=)
Cancelling, and what comes back (=)
What a change covers (=)

english: A change moves you to a different date, a different flight on the same route, or a different route. It never changes who is travelling: a new passenger needs a new booking, whatever the fare.
amharic: ለውጥ ወደ ሌላ ቀን፣ በተመሳሳይ መስመር ወደ ሌላ በረራ፣ ወይም ወደ ሌላ መስመር ያዛውርዎታል። የሚጓዘውን ሰው ግን በጭራሽ አይለውጥም፤ አዲስ ተሳፋሪ ታሪፉ ምንም ይሁን ምን አዲስ የቦታ ማስያዣ ያስፈልገዋል።
back_translation: A change moves you to another date, to another flight on the same route, or to another route. It never changes the person travelling: a new passenger needs a new booking, whatever the fare.
What it costs (=)

english: Two amounts are involved and they are separate. The change fee is set by your fare class and is waived on some fares. The fare difference is the gap between what you paid and the price of the new flight on the day you change it, and no fare waives it.
amharic: ሁለት መጠኖች ይሳተፋሉ፤ እነሱም የተለያዩ ናቸው። የለውጥ ክፍያ በጉዞ ክፍልዎ ይወሰናል፤ በአንዳንድ ታሪፎችም ይነሳል። የታሪፍ ልዩነት ግን በከፈሉትና በሚቀይሩበት ቀን ባለው የአዲሱ በረራ ዋጋ መካከል ያለው ልዩነት ነው፤ ማንኛውም ታሪፍ ይህን አያነሳም።
back_translation: Two amounts are involved and they are separate. The change fee is set by your fare class and is waived on some fares. The fare difference is the gap between what you paid and the price of the new flight on the day you change it, and no fare waives it. (=)

english: If the new flight is cheaper, the difference is not refunded. It stays as a credit against a further change on the same booking.
amharic: አዲሱ በረራ ርካሽ ከሆነ ልዩነቱ ተመላሽ አይደረግም። በተመሳሳይ የቦታ ማስያዣ ላይ ለሚደረግ ሌላ ለውጥ እንደ ክሬዲት ይቆያል።
back_translation: If the new flight is cheaper, the difference is not refunded. It stays as a credit against a further change on the same booking. (=)
What cannot be changed (=)

english: A flight that has already departed. Once a segment is flown or missed, the rest of the booking follows the no-show rules instead.
amharic: አስቀድሞ የተነሳ በረራ። አንድ ክፍል ከተበረረ ወይም ካመለጠ በኋላ የቀረው የቦታ ማስያዣ የአለመቅረብ ደንቦችን ይከተላል።
back_translation: A flight that has already departed. Once a section is flown or missed, the rest of the booking follows the failure-to-appear rules.

english: An award ticket within 72 hours of departure.
amharic: ከመነሻው በ72 ሰዓት ውስጥ ያለ የሽልማት ትኬት።
back_translation: An award ticket within 72 hours of departure. (=)

english: A booking made through a travel agent, which the agent must change.
amharic: በጉዞ ወኪል የተያዘ የቦታ ማስያዣ፤ ወኪሉ መቀየር አለበት።
back_translation: A booking made through a travel agent, which the agent must change. (=)

english: What can be changed, what it costs, and what cannot be changed at all.
amharic: ሊቀየር የሚችለው፣ የሚያስከፍለው፣ እንዲሁም በፍጹም ሊቀየር የማይችለው።
back_translation: What can be changed, what it costs, and what cannot be changed at all. (=)
Changing a booking (=)
Pieces or weight (=)

english: Two systems are in use and the route decides which. On a piece system you get a number of bags, each under a weight cap. On a weight system you get a total, and one bag may be heavier as long as the total holds. Mixing the two -- three bags on a weight route, say -- is what most excess charges come from.
amharic: ሁለት ሥርዓቶች በሥራ ላይ ናቸው፤ የትኛው እንደሚሠራም መስመሩ ይወስናል። በዕቃ ሥርዓት እያንዳንዳቸው ከክብደት ጣሪያ በታች የሆኑ የተወሰኑ ሻንጣዎች ያገኛሉ። በክብደት ሥርዓት ጠቅላላ መጠን ያገኛሉ፤ ጠቅላላው እስከጠበቀ ድረስ አንድ ሻንጣ ሊከብድ ይችላል። ሁለቱን መቀላቀል -- ለምሳሌ በክብደት መስመር ላይ ሦስት ሻንጣ -- አብዛኞቹ የትርፍ ክፍያዎች የሚመጡበት ነው።
back_translation: Two systems are in use and the route decides which. On a piece system you get a number of bags, each under a weight cap. On a weight system you get a total, and one bag may be heavier as long as the total holds. Mixing the two -- three bags on a weight route, say -- is what most excess charges come from. (=)
What shifts the allowance (=)

english: Cabin: Highland Class carries more than economy on every route.
amharic: የጉዞ ክፍል፦ ሃይላንድ ክላስ በእያንዳንዱ መስመር ከኢኮኖሚ የበለጠ ይይዛል።
back_translation: Cabin: Highland Class carries more than economy on every route. (=)

english: Tier: silver and above add a piece or a weight bracket.
amharic: ደረጃ፦ ሲልቨርና ከዚያ በላይ አንድ ዕቃ ወይም የክብደት ደረጃ ይጨምራሉ።
back_translation: Tier: silver and above add a piece or a weight bracket. (=)

english: Passenger type: infants have their own small allowance plus a pushchair.
amharic: የተሳፋሪ ዓይነት፦ ጨቅላዎች የራሳቸው አነስተኛ ፈቃድ እንዲሁም የሕፃን ጋሪ አላቸው።
back_translation: Passenger type: infants have their own small allowance plus a pushchair. (=)

english: This page does not give your number
back_translation: This page does not give your number (=)

english: Allowances differ by route region, cabin and passenger type, so no figure printed here would be right for every reader. The allowance calculator asks for those three and returns the exact allowance for your journey.
amharic: ፈቃዶች በመስመር ክልል፣ በጉዞ ክፍልና በተሳፋሪ ዓይነት ይለያያሉ፤ ስለዚህ እዚህ የታተመ ማንኛውም አኀዝ ለእያንዳንዱ አንባቢ ትክክል አይሆንም። የፈቃድ ማስያው እነዚያን ሦስቱን ጠይቆ ለጉዞዎ ትክክለኛውን ፈቃድ ይመልሳል።
back_translation: Allowances differ by route region, cabin and passenger type, so no figure printed here would be right for every reader. The allowance calculator asks for those three and returns the exact allowance for your journey. (=)

english: How allowances are structured. For your own route, use the allowance calculator.
amharic: ፈቃዶች እንዴት እንደተዋቀሩ። ለራስዎ መስመር የፈቃድ ማስያ ይጠቀሙ።
back_translation: How allowances are structured. For your own route, use the allowance calculator. (=)
Checked baggage, in principle (=)
Reading the flight number (=)

english: A flight sold under our number but flown by another airline is marked 'operated by' on the results page, on your itinerary and on the flight status page. The number you quote at the airport is the operating airline's, not ours.
amharic: በእኛ ቁጥር ተሸጦ በሌላ አየር መንገድ የሚበረር በረራ በውጤቶች ገጽ፣ በጉዞ ዝርዝርዎና በበረራ ሁኔታ ገጽ ላይ ‘የሚከናወነው በ’ ተብሎ ይመዘገባል። በአየር ማረፊያ የሚጠቅሱት ቁጥር የእኛ ሳይሆን የአስኪያጁ አየር መንገድ ነው።
back_translation: A flight sold under our number but flown by another airline is marked 'operated by' on the results page, on your itinerary and on the flight status page. The number you quote at the airport is the operating airline's, not ours. (=)
What follows the operating airline (=)

english: Baggage allowance, cabin service and seat pitch.
amharic: የሻንጣ ፈቃድ፣ የካቢን አገልግሎትና የመቀመጫ ርቀት።
back_translation: Baggage allowance, cabin service and seat pitch. (=)

english: Online check-in, which must be done on their website, not ours.
amharic: የመስመር ላይ ቼክ-ኢን፤ በእነሱ ድረ ገጽ እንጂ በእኛ መደረግ የለበትም።
back_translation: Online check-in, which must be done on their website, not ours. (=)

english: Seat selection, which we cannot make on your behalf.
amharic: የመቀመጫ ምርጫ፤ በእርስዎ ወክለን ልናደርገው አንችልም።
back_translation: Seat selection, which we cannot make on your behalf. (=)
What stays with us (=)

english: The fare rules, the refund, the change fee, and the miles you earn. Those follow the ticket, not the aircraft.
amharic: የታሪፍ ደንቦች፣ ተመላሽ ክፍያው፣ የለውጥ ክፍያውና የሚያገኙት ማይል። እነዚያ ትኬቱን እንጂ አውሮፕላኑን አይከተሉም።
back_translation: The fare rules, the refund, the change fee, and the miles you earn. Those follow the ticket, not the aircraft. (=)

english: What changes when the aircraft is not ours.
back_translation: What changes when the aircraft is not ours. (=)
Flights operated by a partner (=)

english: 60 minutes between two international flights, 90 minutes when one leg is domestic, and 120 minutes when the terminal changes. We do not sell a shorter connection, so anything you can book is long enough.
amharic: በሁለት ዓለም አቀፍ በረራዎች መካከል 60 ደቂቃ፣ አንዱ ክፍል የአገር ውስጥ ሲሆን 90 ደቂቃ፣ ተርሚናል ሲቀየር ደግሞ 120 ደቂቃ። ከዚያ የሚያጥር መሸጋገሪያ አንሸጥም፤ ስለዚህ ሊይዙት የሚችሉት ማንኛውም ነገር በቂ ነው።
back_translation: 60 minutes between two international flights, 90 minutes when one leg is domestic, and 120 minutes when the terminal changes. We do not sell a shorter connection, so anything you can book is long enough. (=)
Long layovers (=)

english: Between 8 and 72 hours on a single booking, a connection becomes a stopover: hotel, airport transfer, lounge and city tour options open up. Below 8 hours it is an ordinary connection and none of those apply.
amharic: በአንድ የቦታ ማስያዣ ላይ ከ8 እስከ 72 ሰዓት ሲሆን መሸጋገሪያ ወደ ማቆያ ይለወጣል፦ የሆቴል፣ የአየር ማረፊያ ትራንስፖርት፣ የላውንጅና የከተማ ጉብኝት አማራጮች ይከፈታሉ። ከ8 ሰዓት በታች ተራ መሸጋገሪያ ነው፤ ከእነዚያም አንዱም አይሠራም።
back_translation: Between 8 and 72 hours on a single booking, a connection becomes a stopover: hotel, airport transfer, lounge and city tour options open up. Below 8 hours it is an ordinary connection and none of those apply. (=)
Staying past the security check [Amharic has no word for 'airside']

english: If you do not leave the transit area you need no visa. The in-terminal hotel, the lounges and the prayer rooms are all airside. Leaving the airport means clearing immigration, and that needs a visa or an e-Visa.
amharic: የመሸጋገሪያ ቀጠናውን ካልለቀቁ ቪዛ አያስፈልግዎትም። በተርሚናል ውስጥ ያለው ሆቴል፣ ላውንጆቹና የጸሎት ክፍሎቹ ሁሉም ከደህንነት ፍተሻ በኋላ ናቸው። አየር ማረፊያውን መልቀቅ ማለት ኢሚግሬሽን ማለፍ ማለት ነው፤ ያም ቪዛ ወይም ኢ-ቪዛ ይፈልጋል።
back_translation: If you do not leave the transit zone you need no visa. The hotel inside the terminal, the lounges and the prayer rooms are all past the security check. Leaving the airport means passing immigration, and that needs a visa or an e-Visa.

english: Minimum times, terminal moves, and what a long layover unlocks.
amharic: አነስተኛ ጊዜያት፣ የተርሚናል ዝውውሮች፣ እና ረጅም ማቆያ የሚከፍተው።
back_translation: Minimum times, terminal moves, and what a long layover unlocks. (=)
Connecting at Addis Ababa (=)
What members get (=)

english: Negotiated fares on the routes you fly most, consolidated monthly billing, waived change fees on Standard and above, and a named account manager.
amharic: በብዛት በሚበሩባቸው መስመሮች ላይ የተደራደሩ ታሪፎች፣ የተጠቃለለ ወርሃዊ ክፍያ፣ በስታንዳርድና ከዚያ በላይ የተነሱ የለውጥ ክፍያዎች፣ እንዲሁም በስም የተመደበ የሒሳብ አስተዳዳሪ።
back_translation: Negotiated fares on the routes you fly most, consolidated monthly billing, change charges lifted on Standard and above, and a named account manager.
Joining (=)

english: Programmes start from USD 50,000 of annual travel spend. Below that, book through the website and earn Selam Miles in the usual way.
amharic: መርሐ ግብሮች ከዓመታዊ USD 50,000 የጉዞ ወጪ ይጀምራሉ። ከዚያ በታች በድረ ገጹ ይያዙ፤ ሰላም ማይልስንም በተለመደው መንገድ ያግኙ።
back_translation: Programmes start from USD 50,000 of annual travel spend. Below that, book through the website and earn Selam Miles in the usual way.

english: What the programme offers, and the threshold to join it.
amharic: መርሐ ግብሩ የሚያቀርበው፣ እና ለመቀላቀል ያለው ደፍ።
back_translation: What the programme offers, and the threshold for joining it.
Corporate travel programme (=)
Declare on arrival (=)

english: Currency above the local threshold, goods for sale, plant and animal products, and anything you were asked to carry for another person. Declaring costs nothing; failing to declare is what carries a penalty.
amharic: ከአገር ውስጥ ገደብ በላይ ያለ ገንዘብ፣ ለሽያጭ የሚሆኑ ዕቃዎች፣ የእጽዋትና የእንስሳት ተዋጽኦዎች፣ እንዲሁም ለሌላ ሰው እንዲይዙ የተጠየቁት ማንኛውም ነገር። ማሳወቅ ምንም አያስከፍልም፤ ቅጣት የሚያስከትለው አለማሳወቅ ነው።
back_translation: Currency above the local threshold, goods for sale, plant and animal products, and anything you were asked to carry for another person. Declaring costs nothing; failing to declare is what carries a penalty. (=)
Duty free on a connection (=)

english: Liquids bought airside travel in a sealed tamper-evident bag with the receipt inside. The seal must be intact at the next screening point. If your onward journey passes through a country that re-screens, buy on the last leg instead.
amharic: ከደህንነት ፍተሻ በኋላ የተገዙ ፈሳሾች ደረሰኙ ውስጡ ሆኖ በማይከፈት ማሸጊያ ከረጢት ውስጥ ይጓዛሉ። ማኅተሙ በሚቀጥለው የፍተሻ ቦታ ሳይነካ መቆየት አለበት። ቀጣይ ጉዞዎ እንደገና በሚፈትሽ አገር የሚያልፍ ከሆነ በምትኩ በመጨረሻው ክፍል ላይ ይግዙ።
back_translation: Liquids bought past the security check travel in a sealed bag with the receipt inside it. The seal must be untouched at the next screening point. If your onward journey passes through a country that screens again, buy on the last section instead.

english: Allowances on arrival, and what must be declared.
amharic: በመድረስ ጊዜ ያሉ ፈቃዶች፣ እና መገለጽ ያለበት።
back_translation: Allowances on arrival, and what must be declared. (=)
Customs and duty free (=)
Seven days (=)

english: Report damage within 7 days of arrival, with the bag, the tag and the boarding pass. We repair where a repair is possible and pay the depreciated value where it is not. After 7 days we cannot accept the claim; this deadline is set by the carriage convention, not by us.
amharic: ጉዳቱን ከደረሱ በ7 ቀናት ውስጥ ከሻንጣው፣ ከመለያውና ከመሳፈሪያ ፈቃዱ ጋር ያሳውቁ። ጥገና በሚቻልበት እንጠግናለን፤ በማይቻልበትም የቀነሰውን ዋጋ እንከፍላለን። ከ7 ቀናት በኋላ ጥያቄውን ልንቀበል አንችልም፤ ይህ የጊዜ ገደብ በእኛ ሳይሆን በማጓጓዝ ስምምነቱ የተቀመጠ ነው።
back_translation: Report damage within 7 days of arrival, with the bag, the tag and the boarding pass. We repair where a repair is possible and pay the depreciated value where it is not. After 7 days we cannot accept the claim; this deadline is set by the carriage convention, not by us. (=)
Not covered (=)

english: Scuffs, scratches, dents and marks from ordinary handling; wheels, feet, handles and straps, which are wear items; overpacking that split a seam; and anything inside a bag that should not have been checked -- money, jewellery, electronics, documents, medication.
amharic: ከተለመደ አያያዝ የሚመጡ ጭረቶች፣ ስንጥቆች፣ ሽንቁሮችና ምልክቶች፤ የሚያልቁ ዕቃዎች የሆኑ ጎማዎች፣ እግሮች፣ እጀታዎችና ማሰሪያዎች፤ ስፌት ያሰነጠቀ ከመጠን በላይ ማሸግ፤ እንዲሁም መመዝገብ የሌለበት በሻንጣ ውስጥ ያለ ማንኛውም ነገር -- ገንዘብ፣ ጌጣጌጥ፣ ኤሌክትሮኒክስ፣ ሰነዶች፣ መድኃኒት።
back_translation: Scuffs, scratches, dents and marks from ordinary handling; wheels, feet, handles and straps, which are wear items; overpacking that split a seam; and anything inside a bag that should not have been checked -- money, jewellery, electronics, documents, medication. (=)

english: The deadline, and the damage we do not cover.
back_translation: The deadline, and the damage we do not cover. (=)
Damaged bags (=)

english: Report it before you leave the airport
back_translation: Report it before you leave the airport (=)

english: Go to the baggage desk in the arrivals hall and open a report. You are given a reference in the form PIR-100001. Reports opened after you leave the airport are accepted for 7 days but are harder to trace, because the bag has left our custody chain.
amharic: በመድረሻ አዳራሽ ወዳለው የሻንጣ ጠረጴዛ ሄደው ሪፖርት ይክፈቱ። በPIR-100001 ቅርጽ ያለ ማጣቀሻ ይሰጥዎታል። አየር ማረፊያውን ከለቀቁ በኋላ የተከፈቱ ሪፖርቶች ለ7 ቀናት ተቀባይነት አላቸው፤ ነገር ግን ሻንጣው ከቁጥጥር ሰንሰለታችን ስለወጣ ለመከታተል ይከብዳሉ።
back_translation: Go to the baggage desk in the arrivals hall and open a report. You are given a reference in the form PIR-100001. Reports opened after you leave the airport are accepted for 7 days but are harder to trace, because the bag has left our custody chain. (=)
note: changed since review; was: በመድረሻ አዳራሽ ወዳለው የሻንጣ ጠረጴዛ ሄደው ሪፖርት ይክፈቱ። በPIR- የሚጀምር ማጣቀሻ ይሰ

back_translation: While it is missing (=)

english: Away from home we reimburse essentials -- toiletries and a change of clothes -- up to USD 100 for the first 48 hours, against receipts. Most bags are located within three days. After 21 days a bag is declared lost and the claim moves to compensation.
amharic: ከቤት ርቀው ሲሆኑ አስፈላጊ ነገሮችን -- የመታጠቢያ ቁሳቁስና የመቀየሪያ ልብስ -- ለመጀመሪያዎቹ 48 ሰዓታት እስከ USD 100 በደረሰኝ እንመልሳለን። አብዛኞቹ ሻንጣዎች በሦስት ቀናት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ከ21 ቀናት በኋላ ሻንጣ እንደጠፋ ተቆጥሮ ጥያቄው ወደ ካሳ ይሸጋገራል።
back_translation: Away from home we reimburse essentials -- toiletries and a change of clothes -- up to USD 100 for the first 48 hours, against receipts. Most bags are located within three days. After 21 days a bag is declared lost and the claim moves to compensation. (=)

english: What to do at the airport, and what we pay while a bag is missing.
amharic: በአየር ማረፊያ ምን ማድረግ እንዳለብዎ፣ እና ሻንጣ በጠፋበት ጊዜ የምንከፍለው።
back_translation: What to do at the airport, and what we pay while a bag is missing. (=)

english: If your bag does not arrive
back_translation: If your bag does not arrive (=)
Seat-back and streaming

english: Wide-body aircraft have seat-back screens with roughly 200 films, 60 series and a music library. Narrow-body aircraft stream the same library to your own device over the on-board network, which does not require a Wi-Fi package.
amharic: ሰፊ አካል ያላቸው አውሮፕላኖች በግምት 200 ፊልሞች፣ 60 ተከታታዮችና የሙዚቃ ቤተ መጻሕፍት ያሉት የመቀመጫ ጀርባ ስክሪን አላቸው። ጠባብ አካል ያላቸው አውሮፕላኖች ተመሳሳዩን ቤተ መጻሕፍት በበረራ ላይ አውታረ መረብ ወደ የራስዎ መሣሪያ ያሰራጫሉ፤ ይህም የዋይ-ፋይ ፓኬጅ አይፈልግም።
back_translation: Wide-body aircraft have a seat-back screen holding roughly 200 films, 60 series and a music library. Narrow-body aircraft stream the same library to your own device over the on-board network; this does not require a Wi-Fi package.

english: What is available, and on which aircraft.
amharic: የሚገኘው ምንድን ነው፣ እና በየትኞቹ አውሮፕላኖች።
back_translation: What is available, and on which aircraft.
In-flight entertainment
Three separate charges (=)

english: Extra weight, charged per kilogram over your allowance.
amharic: ተጨማሪ ክብደት፤ ከፈቃድዎ በላይ በኪሎግራም ይከፈላል።
back_translation: Extra weight, charged per kilogram over your allowance. (=)

english: An extra piece, charged as a flat fee per bag beyond your piece count.
amharic: ተጨማሪ ዕቃ፤ ከዕቃ ብዛትዎ በላይ በአንድ ሻንጣ ቋሚ ክፍያ ይከፈላል።
back_translation: An extra piece, charged as a flat fee per bag beyond your piece count. (=)

english: An outsize or special item, charged at its own fixed fee, which replaces the per-kilogram rate rather than adding to it.
amharic: ከመጠን ያለፈ ወይም ልዩ ዕቃ፤ በራሱ ቋሚ ክፍያ ይከፈላል፤ ይህም በኪሎግራም ተመኑ ላይ ከመጨመር ይልቅ ይተካዋል።
back_translation: An outsize or special item, charged at its own fixed fee, which replaces the per-kilogram rate rather than adding to it. (=)
Prepaying is cheaper (=)

english: Weight bought online before departure costs less per kilogram than weight paid at the bag drop, and a prepaid bundle costs less per kilogram than buying kilos one at a time. The airport rate is the highest of the three and is not negotiable.
amharic: ከመነሻው በፊት በመስመር ላይ የተገዛ ክብደት በሻንጣ ማስረከቢያ ከሚከፈለው በኪሎግራም ያንሳል፤ አስቀድሞ የተከፈለ ጥቅልም ኪሎዎችን አንድ በአንድ ከመግዛት በኪሎግራም ያንሳል። የአየር ማረፊያው ተመን ከሦስቱ ከፍተኛው ነው፤ አይደራደርም።
back_translation: Weight bought online before departure costs less per kilogram than weight paid at the bag drop, and a prepaid bundle costs less per kilogram than buying kilos one at a time. The airport rate is the highest of the three and is not negotiable. (=)

english: The order the charges are applied in, and where each is cheaper.
amharic: ክፍያዎቹ የሚተገበሩበት ቅደም ተከተል፣ እና እያንዳንዱ የሚረክስበት ቦታ።
back_translation: The order the charges are applied in, and where each is cheaper. (=)
How excess is charged (=)
Fare families

english: Promo and Lite fares are neither refundable nor changeable. Basic and Group fares may be changed for a fee but are not refundable. Standard is half refundable. Flex is fully refundable and changes are free. Highland Class fares are refundable in full, with a fee on the Saver family only.
amharic: የፕሮሞና የላይት ታሪፎች ተመላሽም ሆነ የሚቀየሩ አይደሉም። የቤዚክና የግሩፕ ታሪፎች በክፍያ ሊቀየሩ ይችላሉ፤ ተመላሽ ግን አይደረጉም። ስታንዳርድ በግማሽ ተመላሽ ይደረጋል። ፍሌክስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ተመላሽ ይደረጋል፤ ለውጦችም ነጻ ናቸው። የሃይላንድ ክላስ ታሪፎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ተመላሽ ይደረጋሉ፤ ክፍያም በሴቨር ቤተሰብ ላይ ብቻ ነው።
back_translation: Promo and Lite fares are neither refunded nor changeable. Basic and Group fares can be changed for a fee, but are not refunded. Standard is refunded by half. Flex is refunded in full; changes are also free. Highland Class fares are refunded in full, with a fee on the Saver family only.

english: The fare family of your own ticket is shown beside each flight when you open your booking, as a two-letter code such as EF or HC.
amharic: የራስዎ ትኬት የታሪፍ ቤተሰብ የቦታ ማስያዣዎን ሲከፍቱ እንደ EF ወይም HC ባለ የሁለት ፊደል ኮድ ከእያንዳንዱ በረራ ጎን ይታያል።
back_translation: The fare family of your own ticket is shown beside each flight when you open your booking, as a two-letter code such as EF or HC.

english: What each fare family allows, and where to find the rules for your own ticket.
amharic: እያንዳንዱ የታሪፍ ቤተሰብ የሚፈቅደው፣ እና የራስዎን ትኬት ደንቦች የት እንደሚያገኙ።
back_translation: What each fare family permits, and where to find the rules of your own ticket.
Understanding fare rules
Pregnancy (=)

english: You may travel without a letter up to the end of the 28th week. From 29 to 36 weeks bring a letter from a doctor or midwife dated within 10 days of travel. After 36 weeks -- 32 for a multiple pregnancy -- we cannot carry you.
amharic: እስከ 28ኛው ሳምንት መጨረሻ ድረስ ያለ ደብዳቤ መጓዝ ይችላሉ። ከ29 እስከ 36 ሳምንት ከጉዞ በ10 ቀናት ውስጥ የተጻፈ የሐኪም ወይም የአዋላጅ ደብዳቤ ይዘው ይምጡ። ከ36 ሳምንት በኋላ -- ለብዙ እርግዝና 32 -- ልንወስድዎ አንችልም።
back_translation: You may travel without a letter up to the end of the 28th week. From 29 to 36 weeks bring a doctor's or midwife's letter written within 10 days of travel. After 36 weeks -- 32 for a multiple pregnancy -- we cannot carry you.
After surgery or illness (=)

english: Wait 24 hours after keyhole surgery and 10 days after chest or abdominal surgery. After a heart attack, wait 7 days if recovery was uncomplicated. Medical clearance is required inside these periods.
amharic: ከቁልፍ ቀዳዳ ቀዶ ጥገና በኋላ 24 ሰዓት፣ ከደረት ወይም ከሆድ ቀዶ ጥገና በኋላ 10 ቀናት ይጠብቁ። ከልብ ድካም በኋላ ማገገሙ ቀላል ከነበረ 7 ቀናት ይጠብቁ። በእነዚህ ጊዜያት ውስጥ የሕክምና ፈቃድ ያስፈልጋል።
back_translation: Wait 24 hours after keyhole surgery and 10 days after chest or abdominal surgery. After a heart attack, wait 7 days if the recovery was uncomplicated. Medical clearance is required within these periods.
Infants [lit: 'newborns']

english: Infants may fly from seven days old. Below that we carry them only with a neonatal letter.
amharic: ጨቅላዎች ከሰባት ቀን ዕድሜ ጀምሮ መብረር ይችላሉ። ከዚያ በታች የምንወስዳቸው በኒዮናታል ደብዳቤ ብቻ ነው።
back_translation: Infants can fly from seven days of age. Below that we carry them only with a neonatal letter.

english: When you may travel without clearance, and when you may not travel at all.
amharic: ያለ ፈቃድ መጓዝ የሚችሉት መቼ እንደሆነ፣ እና በፍጹም መጓዝ የማይችሉት መቼ እንደሆነ።
back_translation: When you may travel without clearance, and when you may not travel at all.
Fitness to fly (=)
Rebooking and refund

english: Where we cancel a flight or reschedule it by more than three hours, you may take the next available flight at no charge, or request a full refund regardless of the fare rules of your ticket. This is separate from a voluntary change and no change fee or fare difference applies.
amharic: በረራ ስንሰርዝ ወይም ከሦስት ሰዓት በላይ ስናዘገይ፣ ያለክፍያ የሚቀጥለውን ያለ በረራ መውሰድ ወይም የትኬትዎ የታሪፍ ደንቦች ምንም ይሁኑ ምን ሙሉ ተመላሽ ክፍያ መጠየቅ ይችላሉ። ይህ ከፈቃደኝነት ለውጥ የተለየ ሲሆን ምንም የለውጥ ክፍያ ወይም የታሪፍ ልዩነት አይተገበርም።
back_translation: When we cancel a flight or delay it by more than three hours, you may take the next available flight without charge, or request a full refund whatever the fare rules of your ticket may be. This is different from a voluntary change, and no change fee or fare difference is applied.

english: Requests under this policy are handled by the contact office for your country, not by the online refund form.
amharic: በዚህ ፖሊሲ የሚቀርቡ ጥያቄዎች በመስመር ላይ የተመላሽ ክፍያ ቅጽ ሳይሆን በአገርዎ የመገናኛ ቢሮ ይስተናገዳሉ።
back_translation: Requests made under this policy are handled by your country's contact office, not by the online refund form.

english: Your options when the change is ours rather than yours.
amharic: ለውጡ የእኛ እንጂ የእርስዎ ካልሆነ ያሉዎት አማራጮች።
back_translation: The options you have when the change is ours and not yours.

english: If we change or cancel your flight
back_translation: If we change or cancel your flight
Four ways in (=)

english: A Highland Class boarding pass for the flight you are about to take.
amharic: ሊሳፈሩበት ላለው በረራ የሃይላንድ ክላስ የመሳፈሪያ ፈቃድ።
back_translation: A Highland Class boarding pass for the flight you are about to take. (=)

english: Gold or platinum tier, in any cabin, including one guest.
amharic: የወርቅ ወይም የፕላቲነም ደረጃ፣ በማንኛውም የጉዞ ክፍል፣ አንድ እንግዳን ጨምሮ።
back_translation: Gold or platinum tier, in any cabin, including one guest. (=)

english: Silver tier, in any cabin, without a guest.
amharic: የሲልቨር ደረጃ፣ በማንኛውም የጉዞ ክፍል፣ ያለ እንግዳ።
back_translation: Silver tier, in any cabin, without a guest. (=)

english: A walk-in pass bought for the visit, which anyone with a boarding pass may buy.
amharic: ለጉብኝቱ የተገዛ የመግቢያ ፈቃድ፤ የመሳፈሪያ ፈቃድ ያለው ማንኛውም ሰው ሊገዛው ይችላል።
back_translation: A walk-in pass bought for the visit, which anyone with a boarding pass may buy. (=)
What entry includes (=)

english: Buffet and bar, wi-fi, showers where the lounge has them, and a three-hour stay. Entry is at the departure airport only: a lounge at your destination is not part of your ticket, however you got into the one you left from.
amharic: ቡፌና መጠጥ ቤት፣ ዋይ-ፋይ፣ ላውንጁ ሲኖረው ሻወር፣ እንዲሁም የሦስት ሰዓት ቆይታ። መግቢያው በመነሻ አየር ማረፊያ ብቻ ነው፦ ወደ ወጡበት ላውንጅ እንዴት ቢገቡም በመድረሻዎ ያለ ላውንጅ የትኬትዎ አካል አይደለም።
back_translation: Buffet and bar, wi-fi, showers where the lounge has them, and a three-hour stay. Entry is at the departure airport only: a lounge at your destination is not part of your ticket, however you got into the one you left from. (=)

english: The four ways in, and what each one includes.
amharic: አራቱ የመግቢያ መንገዶች፣ እና እያንዳንዱ የሚያካትተው።
back_translation: The four ways in, and what each one includes. (=)
Who gets into a lounge (=)
Clearance

english: Medical clearance is required within 7 days of surgery, for conditions needing supplementary oxygen, for a pregnancy beyond 36 weeks, and where a stretcher or medical escort is needed. Apply at least 72 hours before departure.
amharic: የሕክምና ፈቃድ የሚያስፈልገው በቀዶ ጥገና በ7 ቀናት ውስጥ፣ ተጨማሪ ኦክስጅን ለሚያስፈልጋቸው ሁኔታዎች፣ ከ36 ሳምንት በላይ ለሆነ እርግዝና፣ እና ቃሬዛ ወይም የሕክምና አጃቢ ሲያስፈልግ ነው። ከመነሻው ቢያንስ 72 ሰዓት በፊት ያመልክቱ።
back_translation: Medical clearance is needed within 7 days of surgery, for conditions needing supplementary oxygen, for a pregnancy beyond 36 weeks, and when a stretcher or a medical escort is needed. Apply at least 72 hours before departure.

english: Carry prescribed medication in your cabin baggage in its original labelled packaging, with a doctor's letter for anything injectable.
amharic: የታዘዘ መድኃኒትዎን በዋናው በተለጠፈ ማሸጊያው ውስጥ በእጅ ሻንጣዎ ይያዙ፤ ለሚወጋ ማንኛውም ነገር የሐኪም ደብዳቤ ይዘው።
back_translation: Carry your prescribed medicine in your hand baggage in its original labelled packaging; for anything injected, bring a doctor's letter.

english: When we need medical clearance, and what to bring.
amharic: የሕክምና ፈቃድ የሚያስፈልገን መቼ እንደሆነ፣ እና ምን ይዘው መምጣት እንዳለብዎት።
back_translation: When we need medical clearance, and what you must bring with you.
Travelling with an illness
Rates

english: Miles are earned as a percentage of distance flown, set by fare family: Promo earns nothing, Lite 25%, Basic 50%, Group 75%, Standard 100%, Flex 125%. Highland Class earns 150% to 250% depending on family.
amharic: ማይሎች በበረረው ርቀት መቶኛ ይገኛሉ፤ በታሪፍ ቤተሰብም ይወሰናሉ፦ ፕሮሞ ምንም አያስገኝም፣ ላይት 25%፣ ቤዚክ 50%፣ ግሩፕ 75%፣ ስታንዳርድ 100%፣ ፍሌክስ 125%። ሃይላንድ ክላስ እንደ ቤተሰቡ ከ150% እስከ 250% ያስገኛል።
back_translation: Miles are earned as a percentage of the distance flown; they are also determined by fare family: Promo earns nothing, Lite 25%, Basic 50%, Group 75%, Standard 100%, Flex 125%. Highland Class earns from 150% to 250% depending on the family.

english: Award tickets, staff tickets and the taxes portion of any fare do not earn miles. Miles credit within 72 hours of travel; after that, claim them.
amharic: የሽልማት ትኬቶች፣ የሠራተኛ ትኬቶችና የማንኛውም ታሪፍ የግብር ክፍል ማይል አያስገኙም። ማይሎች በጉዞ በ72 ሰዓት ውስጥ ይመዘገባሉ፤ ከዚያ በኋላ ይጠይቋቸው።
back_translation: Award tickets, staff tickets and the tax portion of any fare earn no miles. Miles are recorded within 72 hours of travel; after that, claim them.

english: Earning rates by fare family, and what does not earn.
amharic: በታሪፍ ቤተሰብ የማግኛ ተመኖች፣ እና የማያስገኘው።
back_translation: Earning rates by fare family, and what earns nothing.
How miles are earned
Validity period

english: Redeemable miles are valid for 36 months from the month they are credited. Any earning or redemption activity extends the whole balance by a further 36 months. An account with no activity for 24 months is made dormant and must be reactivated before miles can be used.
amharic: ሊቤዡ የሚችሉ ማይሎች ከተመዘገቡበት ወር ጀምሮ ለ36 ወራት ይሠራሉ። ማንኛውም የማግኘት ወይም የመቤዠት እንቅስቃሴ ጠቅላላውን ቀሪ ሒሳብ በተጨማሪ 36 ወራት ያራዝማል። ለ24 ወራት እንቅስቃሴ የሌለው ሒሳብ ተኝቶ ይቀመጣል፤ ማይሎች ከመዋላቸው በፊትም እንደገና መንቃት አለበት።
back_translation: Redeemable miles are valid for 36 months from the month they were recorded. Any earning or redemption activity extends the whole remaining balance by a further 36 months. An account with no activity for 24 months is made dormant; it must also be reactivated before the miles can be used.

english: How long miles last and what keeps an account active.
amharic: ማይሎች ምን ያህል እንደሚቆዩና ሒሳብን ንቁ የሚያደርገው።
back_translation: How long miles last and what keeps an account active.
Mile validity and expiry
The pool (=)

english: Up to eight members of one household may pool. Every member keeps their own account and earns as usual; the pool is a shared balance that any nominated member may spend, and the pool head sets who may.
amharic: ከአንድ ቤተሰብ እስከ ስምንት አባላት ማጠራቀም ይችላሉ። እያንዳንዱ አባል የራሱን ሒሳብ ይዞ እንደተለመደው ያገኛል፤ ማጠራቀሚያው ማንኛውም የተመደበ አባል ሊጠቀምበት የሚችል የጋራ ቀሪ ሒሳብ ነው፤ ማን እንደሚችልም የማጠራቀሚያው ኃላፊ ይወስናል።
back_translation: Up to eight members of one household may pool. Every member keeps their own account and earns as usual; the pool is a shared balance that any nominated member may spend, and the pool head sets who may. (=)
What it does not do (=)

english: Pooled miles do not count towards anyone's tier. Qualifying miles stay with the member who flew, so pooling changes what you can spend and never what tier you reach.
amharic: የተጠራቀሙ ማይሎች ለማንም ደረጃ አይቆጠሩም። የብቁነት ማይሎች የበረረው አባል ጋር ይቀራሉ፤ ስለዚህ ማጠራቀም ሊያወጡት የሚችሉትን ይለውጣል እንጂ የሚደርሱበትን ደረጃ በጭራሽ አይለውጥም።
back_translation: Pooled miles do not count towards anyone's tier. Qualifying miles stay with the member who flew, so pooling changes what you can spend and never what tier you reach. (=)

english: Who can join a pool, and what pooling does not do.
amharic: ማን ማጠራቀሚያ መቀላቀል እንደሚችል፣ እና ማጠራቀም የማያደርገው።
back_translation: Who can join a pool, and what pooling does not do. (=)
Pooling miles with family (=)
Thresholds

english: Blue is the entry tier. Silver requires 25,000 qualifying miles in a membership year, Gold 50,000, and Platinum 100,000. Qualifying miles are distance-based and differ from the redeemable miles shown as your balance.
amharic: ብሉ የመግቢያ ደረጃ ነው። ሲልቨር በአባልነት ዓመት ውስጥ 25,000 ብቁ ማይሎችን ይጠይቃል፣ ጎልድ 50,000፣ ፕላቲነም ደግሞ 100,000። ብቁ ማይሎች በርቀት ላይ የተመሠረቱ ሲሆኑ እንደ ቀሪ ሒሳብዎ ከሚታዩት ሊቤዡ ከሚችሉ ማይሎች ይለያሉ።
back_translation: Blue is the entry tier. Silver requires 25,000 qualifying miles within a membership year, Gold 50,000, and Platinum 100,000. Qualifying miles are based on distance and differ from the redeemable miles shown as your remaining balance.

english: Gold and Platinum members and Highland Class passengers have lounge access; Silver does not.
amharic: የጎልድና የፕላቲነም አባላት እንዲሁም የሃይላንድ ክላስ ተሳፋሪዎች የላውንጅ መግቢያ አላቸው፤ ሲልቨር የለውም።
back_translation: Gold and Platinum members, as well as Highland Class passengers, have lounge entry; Silver does not.

english: Thresholds, benefits and how status is retained.
back_translation: Thresholds, benefits and how a tier is retained.
Membership tiers
In the cabin (=)

english: An instrument within the cabin baggage dimensions -- 55 x 38 x 20 cm -- counts as your cabin bag. Violins and flutes normally qualify; guitars do not.
amharic: በእጅ ሻንጣ መጠን ውስጥ ያለ መሣሪያ -- 55 x 38 x 20 ሴሜ -- እንደ የእጅ ሻንጣዎ ይቆጠራል። ቫዮሊንና ፍሉት በተለምዶ ብቁ ናቸው፤ ጊታሮች ግን አይደሉም።
back_translation: An instrument within the cabin-bag size -- 55 x 38 x 20 cm -- counts as your cabin bag. Violins and flutes normally qualify; guitars do not.
On an extra seat (=)

english: Instruments up to 80 kg and 165 cm may travel on a seat bought for them, at the adult fare for the cabin, booked at least 72 hours ahead. The instrument must be in a hard case and is secured by the crew.
amharic: እስከ 80 ኪግ እና 165 ሴሜ የሆኑ መሣሪያዎች ለእነሱ በተገዛ መቀመጫ ላይ በጉዞ ክፍሉ የአዋቂ ታሪፍ ሊጓዙ ይችላሉ፤ ቢያንስ ከ72 ሰዓት በፊት መያዝ አለበት። መሣሪያው በጠንካራ ሳጥን ውስጥ መሆን አለበት፤ በሠራተኞችም ይታሰራል።
back_translation: Instruments up to 80 kg and 165 cm may travel on a seat bought for them, at the adult fare for the cabin class; it must be booked at least 72 hours ahead. The instrument must be in a hard case, and it is secured by the crew.
In the hold (=)

english: Larger instruments travel as checked baggage in a hard flight case, at the special-baggage rate. We do not accept liability for instruments carried in the hold in a soft case.
amharic: ትልልቅ መሣሪያዎች በጠንካራ የበረራ ሳጥን ውስጥ እንደ የተመዘገበ ሻንጣ በልዩ ሻንጣ ተመን ይጓዛሉ። በጭነት ክፍል በለስላሳ ሳጥን ለሚወሰዱ መሣሪያዎች ኃላፊነት አንወስድም።
back_translation: Larger instruments travel as checked baggage in a hard flight case, at the special-baggage rate. We do not take liability for instruments carried in the hold in a soft case.

english: Which instruments travel in the cabin, which need a seat, and which go in the hold.
amharic: የትኞቹ መሣሪያዎች በካቢን እንደሚጓዙ፣ የትኞቹ መቀመጫ እንደሚያስፈልጋቸው፣ የትኞቹም በጭነት ክፍል እንደሚሄዱ።
back_translation: Which instruments travel in the cabin, which need a seat, and which go in the hold.
Musical instruments (=)

english: Corrections we make free of charge
back_translation: Corrections we make free of charge (=)

english: Up to three letters in a first or last name, where the name is clearly the same person -- a transposed pair, a missing letter, an accented character dropped.
amharic: በስም ወይም በአያት ስም ውስጥ እስከ ሦስት ፊደላት፣ ስሙ በግልጽ የአንድ ሰው መሆኑ ሲታወቅ -- የተቀያየሩ ጥንድ፣ የጎደለ ፊደል፣ የወደቀ ምልክት ያለው ፊደል።
back_translation: Up to three letters in a first or last name, where the name is clearly the same person -- a transposed pair, a missing letter, an accented character dropped. (=)
Reversed first and last name. (=)

english: Adding or removing a middle name to match the passport.
amharic: ከፓስፖርቱ ጋር ለማዛመድ የአባት ስም መጨመር ወይም ማንሳት።
back_translation: Adding or removing a middle name to match the passport. (=)
What needs a new booking (=)

english: A different person, a legal name change, or a correction of more than three letters. A ticket is not transferable, so this is a cancellation under your fare rules followed by a fresh purchase.
amharic: ሌላ ሰው፣ ሕጋዊ የስም ለውጥ፣ ወይም ከሦስት ፊደላት በላይ የሆነ እርማት። ትኬት ወደ ሌላ ሰው አይተላለፍም፤ ስለዚህ ይህ በታሪፍ ደንቦችዎ መሠረት መሰረዝ ከዚያም አዲስ ግዢ ነው።
back_translation: A different person, a legal name change, or a correction of more than three letters. A ticket is not transferable, so this is a cancellation under your fare rules followed by a fresh purchase. (=)

english: Bring the correction to us before check-in opens. After a boarding pass is issued the name is fixed and the airport cannot change it.
amharic: እርማቱን ቼክ-ኢን ከመከፈቱ በፊት ያምጡልን። የመሳፈሪያ ፈቃድ ከወጣ በኋላ ስሙ ይቆለፋል፤ አየር ማረፊያውም ሊለውጠው አይችልም።
back_translation: Bring the correction to us before check-in opens. After a boarding pass is issued the name is fixed and the airport cannot change it. (=)

english: Which spelling mistakes we can fix, and which need a new ticket.
amharic: ልናስተካክላቸው የምንችላቸው የፊደል ስህተቶች፣ እና አዲስ ትኬት የሚያስፈልጋቸው።
back_translation: Which spelling mistakes we can fix, and which need a new ticket. (=)
Correcting a name (=)

english: Wide-body aircraft have a universal socket and a USB port at every seat. Narrow-body aircraft have USB only. Turboprops have neither, so charge before you board.
amharic: ሰፊ አካል አውሮፕላኖች በእያንዳንዱ መቀመጫ ሁለንተናዊ ሶኬትና የUSB መሰኪያ አላቸው። ጠባብ አካል አውሮፕላኖች USB ብቻ አላቸው። ተርቦፕሮፖች ደግሞ አንዱም የላቸውም፤ ስለዚህ ከመሳፈርዎ በፊት ኃይል ይሙሉ።
back_translation: Wide-body aircraft have a universal socket and a USB port at every seat. Narrow-body aircraft have USB only. Turboprops have neither, so fill up on power before you board. [turboprop is transliterated]
Amenities (=)

english: Highland Class on flights over six hours carries a flat bed, a duvet and an amenity kit. Economy on the same flights carries a blanket, a pillow and an eye mask on request.
amharic: ሃይላንድ ክላስ ከስድስት ሰዓት በላይ በሚደረጉ በረራዎች ላይ ጠፍጣፋ አልጋ፣ ብርድ ልብስና የአገልግሎት ስብስብ ይይዛል። በተመሳሳይ በረራዎች ላይ ኢኮኖሚ በጥያቄ ብርድ ልብስ፣ ትራስና የዓይን መሸፈኛ ይይዛል።
back_translation: Highland Class on flights over six hours carries a flat bed, a duvet and an amenity kit. Economy on the same flights carries a blanket, a pillow and an eye mask on request. (=)

english: Power, screens and amenities, and which aircraft have them.
amharic: ኃይል፣ ማሳያዎችና አገልግሎቶች፣ እንዲሁም የትኞቹ አውሮፕላኖች እንዳሏቸው።
back_translation: Power, screens and amenities, and which aircraft have them. (=)
What is at your seat (=)
The window (=)

english: Check-in opens 48 hours before departure and closes 2 hours before. Outside that window the page will tell you which of the two applies; it does not queue your request for later.
amharic: ቼክ-ኢን ከመነሻው 48 ሰዓት በፊት ይከፈታል፤ 2 ሰዓት በፊትም ይዘጋል። ከዚያ ጊዜ ውጭ ገጹ ከሁለቱ የትኛው እንደሚሠራ ይነግርዎታል፤ ጥያቄዎን ለኋላ አያስቀምጥም።
back_translation: Check-in opens 48 hours before departure and closes 2 hours before. Outside that window the page will tell you which of the two applies; it does not queue your request for later. (=)
When it will refuse (=)

english: Eight conditions stop online check-in, and each shows its own message rather than a generic failure: too early, closed, an infant on a lap, special assistance booked, an unaccompanied minor, a document check we must do in person, a flight operated by a partner airline, and a group booking.
amharic: ስምንት ሁኔታዎች የመስመር ላይ ቼክ-ኢንን ያስቆማሉ፤ እያንዳንዱም አጠቃላይ የስህተት መልእክት ሳይሆን የራሱን መልእክት ያሳያል፦ በጣም ገና፣ ተዘግቷል፣ በጭን ላይ ያለ ጨቅላ፣ የተያዘ ልዩ እገዛ፣ ያለአጃቢ ሕፃን፣ በአካል ልናደርገው የሚገባ የሰነድ ፍተሻ፣ በአጋር አየር መንገድ የሚከናወን በረራ፣ እንዲሁም የቡድን ቦታ ማስያዣ።
back_translation: Eight conditions stop online check-in, and each shows its own message rather than a generic failure: too early, closed, an infant on a lap, special assistance booked, an unaccompanied minor, a document check we must do in person, a flight operated by a partner airline, and a group booking. (=)

english: In every one of those cases you check in at the airport instead, and the desk closes at the same time as online check-in.
amharic: በእያንዳንዱ በእነዚያ ሁኔታዎች በምትኩ በአየር ማረፊያ ቼክ-ኢን ያደርጋሉ፤ ጠረጴዛውም ከመስመር ላይ ቼክ-ኢን ጋር በተመሳሳይ ሰዓት ይዘጋል።
back_translation: In every one of those cases you check in at the airport instead, and the desk closes at the same time as online check-in. (=)

english: The window, what you need, and the eight reasons it can refuse you.
amharic: የሚከፈትበት ጊዜ፣ የሚያስፈልግዎት፣ እንዲሁም ሊከለክልዎት የሚችልባቸው ስምንት ምክንያቶች።
back_translation: The window, what you need, and the eight reasons it can refuse you. (=)
How online check-in works (=)

english: Quote the number when you book
back_translation: Quote the number when you book (=)

english: Give your membership number at booking, not at the gate. A flight added afterwards credits within 6 to 8 weeks; one that never credits can be claimed for up to 6 months from the flight date, with the ticket number and the boarding pass.
amharic: የአባልነት ቁጥርዎን በበሩ ላይ ሳይሆን ቦታ ሲይዙ ይስጡ። በኋላ የተጨመረ በረራ በ6 እስከ 8 ሳምንታት ውስጥ ይመዘገባል፤ በጭራሽ የማይመዘገብ ደግሞ ከበረራው ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ 6 ወር ድረስ ከትኬት ቁጥሩና ከመሳፈሪያ ፈቃዱ ጋር ሊጠየቅ ይችላል።
back_translation: Give your membership number at booking, not at the gate. A flight added afterwards credits within 6 to 8 weeks; one that never credits can be claimed for up to 6 months from the flight date, with the ticket number and the boarding pass. (=)
Fares that earn nothing (=)

english: Award tickets, staff and industry-discount tickets, tickets bought with a voucher for the full fare, and the deepest promotional fares on partner airlines. The fare rules on your booking say which applies.
amharic: የሽልማት ትኬቶች፣ የሠራተኛና የኢንዱስትሪ ቅናሽ ትኬቶች፣ ሙሉ ታሪፉን በቫውቸር የተገዙ ትኬቶች፣ እንዲሁም በአጋር አየር መንገዶች ላይ ያሉ በጣም ጥልቅ የቅናሽ ታሪፎች። በቦታ ማስያዣዎ ላይ ያሉት የታሪፍ ደንቦች የትኛው እንደሚሠራ ይናገራሉ።
back_translation: Award tickets, staff and industry-discount tickets, tickets bought with a voucher for the full fare, and the deepest promotional fares on partner airlines. The fare rules on your booking say which applies. (=)

english: How to credit a partner flight, and when it will not credit.
amharic: የአጋር በረራን እንዴት ማስመዝገብ እንደሚቻል፣ እና መቼ እንደማይመዘገብ።
back_translation: How to credit a partner flight, and when it will not credit. (=)
Earning on partner flights (=)
Accepted methods (=)

english: Major credit and debit cards, in USD.
amharic: ዋና ዋና የክሬዲትና የዴቢት ካርዶች፣ በUSD።
back_translation: Major credit and debit cards, in USD. (=)

english: Bank transfer, for bookings made more than 14 days before departure. The booking is held for 72 hours while the transfer clears.
amharic: የባንክ ዝውውር፣ ከመነሻው ከ14 ቀን በላይ አስቀድመው ለሚያዙ ቦታዎች። ዝውውሩ እስኪጠናቀቅ የቦታ ማስያዣው ለ72 ሰዓት ይያዛል።
back_translation: Bank transfer, for bookings made more than 14 days before departure. The booking is held for 72 hours while the transfer clears. (=)

english: Gift vouchers, in part or in full, against the base fare.
amharic: የስጦታ ቫውቸሮች፣ በከፊል ወይም በሙሉ፣ በመሠረታዊ ታሪፉ ላይ።
back_translation: Gift vouchers, in part or in full, against the base fare. (=)

english: Selam Miles, for award tickets and for upgrades.
back_translation: Selam Miles, for award tickets and for upgrades. (=)
What we do not accept (=)

english: Cash at the airport for a web booking, cheques, and payment by a third party whose name is not on the booking. Taxes and carrier charges cannot be paid in vouchers.
amharic: በድረ ገጽ ለተያዘ ቦታ በአየር ማረፊያ ጥሬ ገንዘብ፣ ቼኮች፣ እንዲሁም ስሙ በቦታ ማስያዣው ላይ ባልሆነ ሦስተኛ ወገን ክፍያ። ግብሮችና የአጓጓዥ ክፍያዎች በቫውቸር ሊከፈሉ አይችሉም።
back_translation: Cash at the airport for a web booking, cheques, and payment by a third party whose name is not on the booking. Taxes and carrier charges cannot be paid in vouchers. (=)

english: Cards, bank transfer, vouchers and miles, and when each is available.
amharic: ካርዶች፣ የባንክ ዝውውር፣ ቫውቸሮችና ማይሎች፣ እንዲሁም እያንዳንዱ የሚገኝበት ጊዜ።
back_translation: Cards, bank transfer, vouchers and miles, and when each is available. (=)
Ways to pay (=)
Batteries and devices that run on power

english: Spare lithium batteries up to 100 Wh travel in the cabin only, with terminals taped. Between 100 and 160 Wh you may carry two, with prior approval. Above 160 Wh we cannot carry them at all.
amharic: እስከ 100 ዋት-ሰዓት የሆኑ ተጠባባቂ የሊቲየም ባትሪዎች ተርሚናሎቻቸው ተለጥፎ በካቢን ብቻ ይጓዛሉ። ከ100 እስከ 160 ዋት-ሰዓት ባለው በቅድሚያ ፈቃድ ሁለት መያዝ ይችላሉ። ከ160 ዋት-ሰዓት በላይ በፍጹም ልንወስዳቸው አንችልም።
back_translation: Spare lithium batteries up to 100 watt-hours travel in the cabin only, with their terminals taped. Between 100 and 160 watt-hours you may carry two, with prior permission. Above 160 watt-hours we cannot carry them at all.

english: Powered wheelchairs are carried, but the battery type must be declared at least 48 hours ahead so the right handling is arranged.
amharic: በኃይል የሚሠሩ የተሽከርካሪ ወንበሮች ይወሰዳሉ፤ ነገር ግን ትክክለኛው አያያዝ እንዲዘጋጅ የባትሪው ዓይነት ቢያንስ ከ48 ሰዓት በፊት መገለጽ አለበት።
back_translation: Powered wheelchairs are carried, but the battery type must be declared at least 48 hours ahead so the right handling can be arranged.
Liquids, aerosols and gels (=)

english: In the cabin: containers of up to 100 ml, in one transparent bag of up to one litre. In the hold: up to 2 litres of any single item and 2 kg in total, for toiletries and medicines only.
amharic: በካቢን፦ እስከ 100 ሚሊ ሊትር የሆኑ ዕቃዎች፣ እስከ አንድ ሊትር በሚደርስ አንድ ግልጽ ከረጢት ውስጥ። በጭነት ክፍል፦ ለመታጠቢያ ቁሳቁስና ለመድኃኒት ብቻ የአንድ ዕቃ እስከ 2 ሊትር እና በጠቅላላ 2 ኪግ።
back_translation: In the cabin: items of up to 100 millilitres, inside one transparent bag holding up to one litre. In the hold: up to 2 litres of a single item and 2 kg in total, for toiletries and medicines only.
Sharp and pointed items (=)

english: Scissors with blades under 6 cm are allowed in the cabin. Anything longer, and all knives, tools and needles other than medical ones, must be checked.
amharic: ከ6 ሴሜ በታች ምላጭ ያላቸው መቀሶች በካቢን ይፈቀዳሉ። ከዚያ የሚረዝም ማንኛውም ነገር፣ እንዲሁም ሁሉም ቢላዎች፣ መሣሪያዎችና ከሕክምና ውጭ ያሉ መርፌዎች መመዝገብ አለባቸው።
back_translation: Scissors with blades under 6 cm are allowed in the cabin. Anything longer than that, and all knives, tools and non-medical needles, must be checked.

english: The full list, by category, with where each may travel.
amharic: በምድብ የተሟላው ዝርዝር፣ እያንዳንዱ የት መጓዝ እንደሚችል።
back_translation: The complete list by category, and where each may travel.
Dangerous goods and restricted items (=)
The markings (=)

english: Window: against the cabin wall, with no direct access to the aisle.
amharic: መስኮት፦ ከካቢን ግድግዳ ጋር፣ ወደ መተላለፊያ ቀጥታ መድረሻ የለውም።
back_translation: Window: against the cabin wall, with no direct access to the aisle. (=)

english: Aisle: beside the aisle, the easiest seat to leave the row from.
amharic: መተላለፊያ፦ ከመተላለፊያው አጠገብ፤ ከረድፉ ለመውጣት ቀላሉ መቀመጫ።
back_translation: Aisle: beside the aisle, the easiest seat to leave the row from. (=)

english: Bulkhead: the first row of a cabin. More legroom, but nothing in front to store a bag under, so everything goes in the overhead locker for take-off.
amharic: የፊት ግድግዳ፦ የካቢን የመጀመሪያ ረድፍ። ተጨማሪ የእግር ቦታ አለው፤ ግን ከፊት ሻንጣ ማስቀመጫ ስለሌለ ለመነሳት ሁሉም ነገር ወደ ላይኛው ማስቀመጫ ይሄዳል።
back_translation: Front wall: the first row of a cabin. It has extra legroom, but there is no bag storage in front, so for take-off everything goes into the locker above. [Amharic renders 'bulkhead' as 'the front wall']

english: Exit row: extra legroom, and a duty to help the crew in an evacuation.
amharic: የመውጫ ረድፍ፦ ተጨማሪ የእግር ቦታ፤ እንዲሁም በመልቀቅ ጊዜ ሠራተኞችን የመርዳት ግዴታ።
back_translation: Exit row: extra legroom, and a duty to help the crew in an evacuation. (=)

english: Bassinet: a bassinet can be fitted, so these are held for passengers with an infant.
amharic: የሕፃን አልጋ፦ የሕፃን አልጋ ሊገጠም ስለሚችል እነዚህ ጨቅላ ላላቸው ተሳፋሪዎች ይያዛሉ።
back_translation: Baby's bed: a baby's bed can be fitted, so these are held for passengers with an infant.

english: Who may not sit in an exit row
back_translation: Who may not sit in an exit row (=)

english: Passengers under 15, passengers travelling with an infant, passengers who need an extension seatbelt, and anyone who would find it hard to operate a heavy door. Cabin crew reseat anyone who does not qualify, and the seat charge is refunded.
amharic: ከ15 ዓመት በታች ያሉ ተሳፋሪዎች፣ ከጨቅላ ጋር የሚጓዙ ተሳፋሪዎች፣ ተጨማሪ የመቀመጫ ቀበቶ የሚያስፈልጋቸው ተሳፋሪዎች፣ እንዲሁም ከባድ በር ማንቀሳቀስ የሚከብደው ማንኛውም ሰው። የካቢን ሠራተኞች ብቁ ያልሆነውን ማንኛውንም ሰው ያዛውራሉ፤ የመቀመጫው ክፍያም ተመላሽ ይደረጋል።
back_translation: Passengers under 15, passengers travelling with an infant, passengers who need an extension seatbelt, and anyone who would find it hard to operate a heavy door. Cabin crew reseat anyone who does not qualify, and the seat charge is refunded. (=)

english: Window, aisle, bulkhead, exit row and bassinet, and who may sit where.
amharic: መስኮት፣ መተላለፊያ፣ የፊት ግድግዳ፣ የመውጫ ረድፍና የሕፃን አልጋ፣ እንዲሁም ማን የት መቀመጥ እንደሚችል።
back_translation: Window, aisle, bulkhead, exit row and bassinet, and who may sit where. (=)
What the seat markings mean (=)
The liquid rule (=)

english: Containers of up to 100 ml, all together in one transparent resealable bag of up to one litre, one bag per passenger. A 200 ml bottle that is half empty is still refused: the rule is the container size, not the amount inside it.
amharic: እስከ 100 ሚሊ ሊትር የሆኑ ዕቃዎች፣ ሁሉም በአንድነት እስከ አንድ ሊትር በሚይዝ አንድ ግልጽና እንደገና በሚዘጋ ከረጢት ውስጥ፣ በአንድ ተሳፋሪ አንድ ከረጢት። ግማሽ ባዶ የሆነ የ200 ሚሊ ሊትር ጠርሙስ አሁንም አይፈቀድም፦ ደንቡ በውስጡ ያለው መጠን ሳይሆን የዕቃው መጠን ነው።
back_translation: Containers of up to 100 ml, all together in one transparent resealable bag of up to one litre, one bag per passenger. A 200 ml bottle that is half empty is still refused: the rule is the container size, not the amount inside it. (=)
Exempt from the bag (=)

english: Baby food and milk for a travelling infant, and prescription medication, in the quantity needed for the journey. Declare both at the checkpoint. Screening staff may ask you to open them.
amharic: ለሚጓዝ ጨቅላ የሚሆን የሕፃን ምግብና ወተት፣ እንዲሁም በሐኪም የታዘዘ መድኃኒት፣ ለጉዞው በሚያስፈልገው መጠን። ሁለቱንም በፍተሻ ቦታው ላይ ያሳውቁ። የፍተሻ ሠራተኞች እንዲከፍቷቸው ሊጠይቁዎት ይችላሉ።
back_translation: Baby food and milk for a travelling infant, and prescription medication, in the quantity needed for the journey. Declare both at the checkpoint. Screening staff may ask you to open them. (=)
Out of the bag (=)

english: Laptops and tablets, the liquids bag, and coats. Shoes and belts only if asked. Duty free bought before a connection stays sealed in its tamper-evident bag with the receipt visible, or it will be taken at the next checkpoint.
amharic: ላፕቶፖችና ታብሌቶች፣ የፈሳሽ ከረጢቱ፣ እንዲሁም ኮቶች። ጫማና ቀበቶ የሚጠየቁት ሲጠየቁ ብቻ ነው። ከመሸጋገሪያ በፊት የተገዛ ከቀረጥ ነጻ ዕቃ ደረሰኙ እየታየ በማይከፈት ከረጢቱ ውስጥ ታሽጎ መቆየት አለበት፤ አለበለዚያ በሚቀጥለው የፍተሻ ቦታ ይወሰዳል።
back_translation: Laptops and tablets, the liquids bag, and coats. Shoes and belts only if asked. Duty free bought before a connection stays sealed in its tamper-evident bag with the receipt visible, or it will be taken at the next checkpoint. (=)

english: What comes out of the bag, and the liquid rule.
back_translation: What comes out of the bag, and the liquid rule. (=)
Security screening (=)
Smoking (=)

english: Smoking is prohibited on every flight, in every cabin, including electronic cigarettes and heated tobacco. Lavatory smoke detectors are monitored and tampering with one is an offence in its own right.
amharic: ማጨስ በእያንዳንዱ በረራ፣ በእያንዳንዱ ካቢን የተከለከለ ነው፤ የኤሌክትሮኒክ ሲጋራዎችንና የሚሞቅ ትምባሆን ጨምሮ። የመጸዳጃ ቤት የጭስ ማወቂያዎች ይቆጣጠራሉ፤ አንዱን መንካትም በራሱ ወንጀል ነው።
back_translation: Smoking is prohibited on every flight, in every cabin, including electronic cigarettes and heated tobacco. Lavatory smoke detectors are monitored and tampering with one is an offence in its own right. (=)
Electronic cigarettes in baggage (=)

english: Carry them in the cabin, never in the hold, and do not charge them on board. This is the same lithium-battery rule that applies to power banks.
amharic: በካቢን ይያዟቸው፤ በጭነት ክፍል በጭራሽ አይሁን፤ በበረራ ላይም አይሙሏቸው። ይህ ለኃይል ማጠራቀሚያዎች የሚሠራው ተመሳሳይ የሊቲየም ባትሪ ደንብ ነው።
back_translation: Carry them in the cabin, never in the hold, and do not charge them on board. This is the same lithium-battery rule that applies to power banks. (=)
Flight mode (=)

english: Phones, tablets and laptops may be used in flight mode throughout. Larger devices are stowed for take-off and landing. Bluetooth headphones are permitted; a device that cannot be switched to flight mode must be off.
amharic: ስልኮች፣ ታብሌቶችና ላፕቶፖች በበረራው ጊዜ ሁሉ በበረራ ሁኔታ ሊውሉ ይችላሉ። ትልልቅ መሣሪያዎች ለመነሳትና ለማረፍ ይቀመጣሉ። የብሉቱዝ ማዳመጫዎች ይፈቀዳሉ፤ ወደ በረራ ሁኔታ ሊቀየር የማይችል መሣሪያ ግን መጥፋት አለበት።
back_translation: Phones, tablets and laptops may be used in flight mode throughout. Larger devices are stowed for take-off and landing. Bluetooth headphones are permitted; a device that cannot be switched to flight mode must be off. (=)

english: What is prohibited outright, and what flight mode covers.
amharic: በፍጹም የተከለከለው፣ እና የበረራ ሁኔታ የሚሸፍነው።
back_translation: What is prohibited outright, and what flight mode covers. (=)
Smoking and electronic devices (=)
How special baggage is charged

english: Sports equipment counts as one checked bag if it is within your free allowance and under the weight limit for the item. Anything above that is charged at the fixed item fee below, which replaces the normal excess-weight rate.
amharic: የስፖርት መሣሪያ በነጻ ፈቃድዎ ውስጥ ከሆነና ከዕቃው የክብደት ገደብ በታች ከሆነ እንደ አንድ የተመዘገበ ሻንጣ ይቆጠራል። ከዚያ በላይ የሆነው ከታች ባለው ቋሚ የዕቃ ክፍያ ይከፈላል፤ ይህም መደበኛውን የትርፍ ክብደት ተመን ይተካል።
back_translation: Sports equipment counts as one registered bag if it is within your free allowance and below the item's weight limit. Anything above that is paid at the fixed item charge below; this also replaces the ordinary excess-weight rate.

english: Items marked as requiring advance notice must be declared at least 48 hours before departure. We cannot accept them at the airport without a booking.
amharic: ቅድሚያ ማሳወቅ የሚያስፈልጋቸው ተብለው የተመዘገቡ ዕቃዎች ከመነሻው ቢያንስ 48 ሰዓት በፊት መገለጽ አለባቸው። ያለ ቅድመ ማስያዣ በአየር ማረፊያ ልንቀበላቸው አንችልም።
back_translation: Items recorded as requiring advance notice must be declared at least 48 hours before departure. Without a prior booking we cannot accept them at the airport.
Packing requirements

english: Bicycles must have the handlebars turned, pedals removed and tyres deflated, in a bicycle bag or box.
amharic: ብስክሌቶች መሪያቸው ተዙሮ፣ ፔዳሎቻቸው ተነስተውና ጎማዎቻቸው አየር ወጥቶላቸው በብስክሌት ከረጢት ወይም ሳጥን መሆን አለባቸው።
back_translation: Bicycles must be in a bicycle bag or box with their handlebars turned, their pedals removed and their tyres deflated.

english: Firearms for sport require a permit and must be declared; ammunition is limited to 5 kg per passenger and must travel separately from the firearm.
amharic: ለስፖርት የሚውሉ የጦር መሣሪያዎች ፈቃድ ያስፈልጋቸዋል፤ መገለጽም አለባቸው። ጥይት በአንድ ተሳፋሪ እስከ 5 ኪግ የተወሰነ ሲሆን ከመሣሪያው ተለይቶ መጓዝ አለበት።
back_translation: Firearms used for sport require a permit; they must also be declared. Ammunition is limited to 5 kg per passenger and must travel separately from the firearm.

english: Surfboards and windsurf equipment must be in a padded board bag.
amharic: የሰርፍ ሰሌዳዎችና የንፋስ ሰርፍ መሣሪያዎች በተለጠፈ የሰሌዳ ከረጢት ውስጥ መሆን አለባቸው።
back_translation: Surfboards and windsurf equipment must be inside a padded board bag.

english: Diving cylinders must be empty, with the valve removed or open for inspection.
amharic: የመጥለቂያ ሲሊንደሮች ባዶ መሆን አለባቸው፤ ቫልቫቸውም ተነስቶ ወይም ለፍተሻ ክፍት መሆን አለበት።
back_translation: Diving cylinders must be empty; their valve must also be removed or open for inspection.
Items we cannot carry

english: Loose lithium batteries above 160 Wh, powered ride-on suitcases with non-removable batteries, and hoverboards are not accepted in either cabin or hold baggage on any route.
amharic: ከ160 ዋት-ሰዓት በላይ የሆኑ ነጠላ የሊቲየም ባትሪዎች፣ የማይነሱ ባትሪ ያላቸው በኤሌክትሪክ የሚነዱ ሻንጣዎችና ሆቨርቦርዶች በማንኛውም መስመር በእጅም ሆነ በተመዘገበ ሻንጣ አይፈቀዱም።
back_translation: Single lithium batteries above 160 watt-hours, electrically driven suitcases with non-removable batteries, and hoverboards are not permitted on any route, in either hand or registered baggage.

english: Rules, weight limits and charges for sports equipment and outsize items.
amharic: ለስፖርት መሣሪያዎችና ለትልልቅ ዕቃዎች ደንቦች፣ የክብደት ገደቦችና ክፍያዎች።
back_translation: Rules, weight limits and charges for sports equipment and outsize items.
Special and sports baggage
Ordering

english: Special meals must be requested at least 24 hours before departure through your booking. They cannot be arranged at the airport or on board, and a request made inside the cut-off will not be loaded.
amharic: ልዩ ምግቦች ከመነሻው ቢያንስ 24 ሰዓት በፊት በቦታ ማስያዣዎ በኩል መጠየቅ አለባቸው። በአየር ማረፊያ ወይም በበረራ ላይ ሊዘጋጁ አይችሉም፤ ከመዝጊያው በኋላ የቀረበ ጥያቄም አይጫንም።
back_translation: Special meals must be requested through your booking at least 24 hours before departure. They cannot be prepared at the airport or on the flight; a request submitted after the closing time is also not loaded.

english: A special meal is prepared to a dietary specification. It is not an allergy control: it reduces but does not remove the risk of cross-contact, and the cabin itself is not allergen-free.
amharic: ልዩ ምግብ በአመጋገብ መስፈርት ይዘጋጃል። የአለርጂ ቁጥጥር አይደለም፤ የመተላለፍ አደጋን ይቀንሳል እንጂ አያስወግድም፤ ካቢኑም ራሱ አለርጂ-ነጻ አይደለም።
back_translation: A special meal is prepared to a dietary specification. It is not an allergy control; it reduces the risk of cross-contact but does not remove it, and the cabin itself is not allergen-free.
The codes we carry

english: VGML vegetarian, VJML Jain vegetarian, AVML Asian vegetarian.
amharic: VGML ቬጀቴሪያን፣ VJML ጃይን ቬጀቴሪያን፣ AVML እስያዊ ቬጀቴሪያን።
back_translation: VGML vegetarian, VJML Jain vegetarian, AVML Asian vegetarian.

english: GFML gluten intolerant, LFML low fat, LSML low salt, DBML diabetic.
amharic: GFML ግሉተን የማይስማማው፣ LFML ዝቅተኛ ስብ፣ LSML ዝቅተኛ ጨው፣ DBML የስኳር በሽተኛ።
back_translation: GFML gluten-intolerant, LFML low fat, LSML low salt, DBML diabetic.

english: HNML Hindu, MOML Muslim, KSML kosher, ORML Orthodox fasting.
amharic: HNML ሂንዱ፣ MOML ሙስሊም፣ KSML ኮሸር፣ ORML የኦርቶዶክስ ጾም።
back_translation: HNML Hindu, MOML Muslim, KSML kosher, ORML Orthodox fasting.

english: CHML child, BBML infant, FPML fruit platter.
amharic: CHML የሕፃናት፣ BBML የጨቅላ፣ FPML የፍራፍሬ ሳህን።
back_translation: CHML for children, BBML for infants, FPML fruit platter.

english: The meal codes we carry and when they must be ordered.
amharic: የምንይዛቸው የምግብ ኮዶችና መቼ መታዘዝ እንዳለባቸው።
back_translation: The meal codes we carry and when they must be ordered.
Special meals
The short version (=)
