english: Most sports equipment travels as one checked piece if it is inside your allowance and under the item's weight cap. Bulky items -- bicycles, surfboards, kayaks, windsurf rigs -- carry a fixed fee instead of the per-kilogram rate, and several must be declared before you travel.
amharic: አብዛኛው የስፖርት መሣሪያ በፈቃድዎ ውስጥና ከዕቃው የክብደት ጣሪያ በታች ከሆነ እንደ አንድ የተመዘገበ ዕቃ ይጓዛል። ግዙፍ ዕቃዎች -- ብስክሌት፣ የሰርፍ ቦርድ፣ ካያክ፣ የንፋስ ሰርፍ መሣሪያ -- በኪሎግራም ተመን ፋንታ ቋሚ ክፍያ አላቸው፤ ብዙዎቹም ከመጓዝዎ በፊት መገለጽ አለባቸው።
back_translation: Most sports equipment travels as one checked piece if it is inside your allowance and under the item's weight cap. Bulky items -- bicycles, surfboards, kayaks, windsurf rigs -- carry a fixed fee instead of the per-kilogram rate, and several must be declared before you travel. (=)
What this page leaves out (=)

english: It does not say how any item must be packed, which fee applies to which item, or which items we refuse. Those are on the special and sports baggage page, and the airport goes by that page rather than by this summary.
amharic: ማንኛውም ዕቃ እንዴት መታሸግ እንዳለበት፣ የትኛው ክፍያ ለየትኛው ዕቃ እንደሚሠራ፣ ወይም የትኞቹን ዕቃዎች እንደምንከለክል አይናገርም። እነዚያ በልዩና በስፖርት ሻንጣ ገጽ ላይ ናቸው፤ አየር ማረፊያውም በዚህ ማጠቃለያ ሳይሆን በዚያ ገጽ ይሄዳል።
back_translation: It does not say how any item must be packed, which fee applies to which item, or which items we refuse. Those are on the special and sports baggage page, and the airport goes by that page rather than by this summary. (=)

english: A short summary. The full rules, with packing requirements, are on the special baggage page.
amharic: አጭር ማጠቃለያ። ሙሉ ደንቦቹ ከማሸጊያ መስፈርቶች ጋር በልዩ ሻንጣ ገጽ ላይ ናቸው።
back_translation: A short summary. The full rules, with packing requirements, are on the special baggage page. (=)
Sports equipment at a glance (=)

english: Most destinations require a passport valid for at least six months beyond your date of arrival, with at least two blank pages. It is the passenger's responsibility to hold the correct documents; we are required to refuse carriage where they are not in order.
amharic: አብዛኞቹ መዳረሻዎች ከመድረሻ ቀንዎ ቢያንስ ለስድስት ወራት የሚሠራ ፓስፖርት ይጠይቃሉ፤ ቢያንስ ሁለት ባዶ ገጾችም ሊኖሩት ይገባል። ትክክለኛ ሰነዶችን መያዝ የተሳፋሪው ኃላፊነት ነው፤ በሥርዓት ካልሆኑም ጉዞን እንድንከለክል እንገደዳለን።
back_translation: Most destinations require a passport valid for at least six months from your date of arrival; it should also have at least two blank pages. Holding correct documents is the passenger's responsibility; if they are not in order we are obliged to refuse carriage.

english: Validity rules and the checks we make at the airport.
amharic: የጊዜ ገደብ ደንቦችና በአየር ማረፊያ የምናደርጋቸው ፍተሻዎች።
back_translation: Validity rules and the checks we make at the airport.
Passports and travel documents
Keep it in the cabin (=)

english: Prescription medication travels in your cabin bag, in its original labelled packaging, in the quantity needed for the journey plus a few days. Hold baggage can be delayed, and the hold is cold.
amharic: በሐኪም የታዘዘ መድኃኒት በእጅ ሻንጣዎ ውስጥ፣ በመጀመሪያው መለያ ባለው ማሸጊያው፣ ለጉዞው በሚያስፈልገው መጠን ላይ የጥቂት ቀናት ተጨምሮ ይጓዛል። የተመዘገበ ሻንጣ ሊዘገይ ይችላል፤ የጭነት ክፍሉም ቀዝቃዛ ነው።
back_translation: Prescription medication travels in your cabin bag, in its original labelled packaging, in the quantity needed for the journey plus a few days. Hold baggage can be delayed, and the hold is cold. (=)
The letter (=)

english: Carry a doctor's letter naming the medication and the condition if you travel with injectables, controlled drugs, liquids above 100 ml, or a device such as a syringe driver. Some destinations restrict medicines that are ordinary elsewhere; check with the embassy rather than assuming.
amharic: የመርፌ መድኃኒት፣ ቁጥጥር የሚደረግባቸው መድኃኒቶች፣ ከ100 ሚሊ ሊትር በላይ ፈሳሾች፣ ወይም እንደ የመርፌ መሣሪያ ያለ መሣሪያ ይዘው የሚጓዙ ከሆነ መድኃኒቱንና ሕመሙን የሚጠቅስ የሐኪም ደብዳቤ ይያዙ። አንዳንድ መድረሻዎች በሌላ ቦታ የተለመዱ መድኃኒቶችን ይገድባሉ፤ ከመገመት ይልቅ ከኤምባሲው ያረጋግጡ።
back_translation: Carry a doctor's letter naming the medication and the condition if you travel with injectables, controlled drugs, liquids above 100 ml, or a device such as a syringe driver. Some destinations restrict medicines that are ordinary elsewhere; check with the embassy rather than assuming. (=)

english: Where it goes, and the letter that prevents a problem.
amharic: የት እንደሚቀመጥ፣ እና ችግርን የሚከላከለው ደብዳቤ።
back_translation: Where it goes, and the letter that prevents a problem. (=)
Travelling with medication (=)

english: Cats and dogs up to 8 kg including the carrier may travel in the cabin, at USD 90 per sector. The carrier must fit under the seat in front, and only one animal per passenger is accepted.
amharic: ድመቶችና ውሾች ማጓጓዣውን ጨምሮ እስከ 8 ኪግ በካቢን ውስጥ በአንድ ክፍል USD 90 ሊጓዙ ይችላሉ። ማጓጓዣው በፊት መቀመጫ ሥር መግባት አለበት፤ በአንድ ተሳፋሪም አንድ እንስሳ ብቻ ይፈቀዳል።
back_translation: Cats and dogs up to 8 kg including the carrier may travel in the cabin at USD 90 per sector. The carrier must fit under the seat in front, and only one animal per passenger is allowed.

english: Above 8 kg the animal travels in the hold in an IATA-compliant crate, at USD 200 per sector. We do not carry snub-nosed breeds in the hold on any route, because they cannot regulate their breathing reliably.
amharic: ከ8 ኪግ በላይ እንስሳው በIATA መስፈርት በተዘጋጀ ሳጥን በጭነት ክፍል በአንድ ክፍል USD 200 ይጓዛል። አጭር አፍንጫ ያላቸውን ዝርያዎች በማንኛውም መስመር በጭነት ክፍል አንወስድም፤ ምክንያቱም ትንፋሻቸውን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ መቆጣጠር ስለማይችሉ ነው።
back_translation: Above 8 kg the animal travels in the hold in a crate built to the IATA standard, at USD 200 per sector. We do not carry short-nosed breeds in the hold on any route, because they cannot control their breathing reliably.
Documents (=)

english: Every destination sets its own import rules. A rabies vaccination certificate and an export health certificate are the minimum; some destinations add a titre test with a waiting period of several months. Check before you book.
amharic: እያንዳንዱ መዳረሻ የራሱን የማስገቢያ ደንቦች ያወጣል። የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ ክትባት ምስክር ወረቀትና የወጪ ጤና ምስክር ወረቀት ዝቅተኛው ናቸው፤ አንዳንድ መዳረሻዎች የበርካታ ወራት መጠበቂያ ያለው የቲተር ምርመራ ይጨምራሉ። ከመያዝዎ በፊት ያረጋግጡ።
back_translation: Each destination sets its own import rules. A rabies vaccination certificate and an export health certificate are the minimum; some destinations add a titre test with a waiting period of several months. Check before you book.

english: Cabin and hold rules, weight limits, and the documents each destination needs.
amharic: የካቢንና የጭነት ክፍል ደንቦች፣ የክብደት ገደቦች፣ እና እያንዳንዱ መዳረሻ የሚፈልጋቸው ሰነዶች።
back_translation: Cabin and hold rules, weight limits, and the documents each destination needs.
Travelling with house pets [English says 'pets']
Age bands (=)

english: Under 5 may not travel alone. From 5 to 11 the escort service is compulsory and costs USD 60 each way. From 12 to 15 it is optional at the same price. From 16 the passenger travels as an adult.
amharic: ከ5 ዓመት በታች ብቻቸውን መጓዝ አይችሉም። ከ5 እስከ 11 የአጃቢ አገልግሎት የግዴታ ሲሆን በአንድ አቅጣጫ USD 60 ያስከፍላል። ከ12 እስከ 15 በተመሳሳይ ዋጋ በምርጫ ነው። ከ16 ጀምሮ ተሳፋሪው እንደ አዋቂ ይጓዛል።
back_translation: Under 5 cannot travel alone. From 5 to 11 the escort service is compulsory and charges USD 60 each way. From 12 to 15 it is by choice at the same price. From 16 the passenger travels as an adult.
Before travel (=)

english: Book at least 48 hours ahead and name the adult handing over and the adult collecting, with a telephone number for each. Both must bring photographic identification. A booking with an unaccompanied minor cannot be checked in online.
amharic: ቢያንስ ከ48 ሰዓት በፊት ይያዙ፤ የሚያስረክበውንና የሚቀበለውን አዋቂ ከየስልክ ቁጥራቸው ጋር ይሰይሙ። ሁለቱም ፎቶ ያለው መታወቂያ ማምጣት አለባቸው። ያለአጃቢ ሕፃን ያለበት የቦታ ማስያዣ በመስመር ላይ ቼክ-ኢን ሊደረግ አይችልም።
back_translation: Book at least 48 hours ahead and name the adult handing over and the adult collecting, with a telephone number for each. Both must bring photographic identification. A booking with an unaccompanied child cannot be checked in online.

english: Age bands, the escort service, and what must be arranged before travel.
amharic: የዕድሜ ክፍሎች፣ የአጃቢ አገልግሎት፣ እና ከጉዞ በፊት መዘጋጀት ያለበት።
back_translation: Age bands, the escort service, and what must be arranged before travel.
Children travelling alone (=)
Yellow fever (=)

english: A yellow fever certificate is required by many countries when you arrive from, or have transited, a country where the disease is present. It becomes valid 10 days after vaccination, so a certificate dated within 10 days of arrival is refused.
amharic: በሽታው ካለበት አገር ሲመጡ ወይም በእሱ ሲሸጋገሩ ብዙ አገሮች የቢጫ ወባ ምስክር ወረቀት ይጠይቃሉ። ከክትባቱ 10 ቀናት በኋላ ሥራ ላይ ይውላል፤ ስለዚህ ከመድረሻ በ10 ቀናት ውስጥ የተጻፈ ምስክር ወረቀት አይቀበልም።
back_translation: A yellow fever certificate is required by many countries when you arrive from, or have transited, a country where the disease is present. It becomes valid 10 days after vaccination, so a certificate dated within 10 days of arrival is refused. (=)
Who decides (=)

english: The destination government, not us. We check that you hold what your destination requires, and we are obliged to refuse carriage if you do not -- but the requirement itself is theirs, and it changes. Confirm with the embassy before you travel.
amharic: የመድረሻው መንግሥት እንጂ እኛ አይደለንም። መድረሻዎ የሚጠይቀውን መያዝዎን እናረጋግጣለን፤ ካልያዙም ማጓጓዝን የመከልከል ግዴታ አለብን። መስፈርቱ ራሱ ግን የእነሱ ነው፤ እንዲሁም ይለወጣል። ከመጓዝዎ በፊት ከኤምባሲው ያረጋግጡ።
back_translation: The destination government, not us. We check that you hold what your destination requires, and we are obliged to refuse carriage if you do not -- but the requirement itself is theirs, and it changes. Confirm with the embassy before you travel. (=)

english: Which certificates are checked, and who decides.
amharic: የትኞቹ ምስክር ወረቀቶች እንደሚፈተሹ፣ እና ማን እንደሚወስን።
back_translation: Which certificates are checked, and who decides. (=)
Vaccinations and health certificates (=)
Carry these yourself (=)

english: Money, jewellery, precious metals, electronics, cameras, keys, passports and other documents, prescription medication, and anything irreplaceable. We accept no liability for these in checked baggage, whether the bag is lost, delayed or damaged.
amharic: ገንዘብ፣ ጌጣጌጥ፣ የከበሩ ማዕድናት፣ ኤሌክትሮኒክስ፣ ካሜራዎች፣ ቁልፎች፣ ፓስፖርቶችና ሌሎች ሰነዶች፣ በሐኪም የታዘዘ መድኃኒት፣ እንዲሁም የማይተካ ማንኛውም ነገር። እነዚህ በተመዘገበ ሻንጣ ውስጥ ሲሆኑ ሻንጣው ይጥፋ፣ ይዘግይ ወይም ይጎዳ ምንም ኃላፊነት አንወስድም።
back_translation: Money, jewellery, precious metals, electronics, cameras, keys, passports and other documents, prescription medication, and anything irreplaceable. We accept no liability for these in checked baggage, whether the bag is lost, delayed or damaged. (=)

amharic: በጭነት ክፍል ውስጥ ያሉ ተሰባሪ ዕቃዎች
back_translation: Fragile items in the hold (=)

english: A fragile item may be checked if it is packed for transport in a rigid case. It is tagged 'limited release', which means we carry it but do not cover damage to it. A fragile tag is not insurance.
amharic: ተሰባሪ ዕቃ በጠንካራ ሳጥን ውስጥ ለማጓጓዝ ታሽጎ ከሆነ ሊመዘገብ ይችላል። ‘ውስን ኃላፊነት’ ተብሎ ይመዘገባል፤ ትርጉሙም እናጓጉዘዋለን እንጂ ጉዳቱን አንሸፍንም ማለት ነው። የተሰባሪ መለያ ዋስትና አይደለም።
back_translation: A fragile item may be checked if it is packed for transport in a rigid case. It is tagged 'limited release', which means we carry it but do not cover damage to it. A fragile tag is not insurance. (=)

english: What must stay with you, and the limit of our liability.
amharic: ከእርስዎ ጋር መቆየት ያለበት፣ እና የኃላፊነታችን ገደብ።
back_translation: What must stay with you, and the limit of our liability. (=)
Valuables and fragile items (=)
Transiting inside the airport

english: A passenger connecting within the same terminal on a single booking generally does not need a transit visa. A visa is needed where the connection requires leaving the transit area, where baggage must be reclaimed and re-checked, or where the layover is long enough that you intend to leave the airport.
amharic: በአንድ የቦታ ማስያዣ በተመሳሳይ ተርሚናል ውስጥ የሚሸጋገር ተሳፋሪ በአጠቃላይ የመሸጋገሪያ ቪዛ አያስፈልገውም። ቪዛ የሚያስፈልገው መሸጋገሪያው የመሸጋገሪያ ቀጠናውን መልቀቅ ሲጠይቅ፣ ሻንጣ ተመልሶ ተወስዶ እንደገና መመዝገብ ሲኖርበት፣ ወይም የማቆያ ጊዜው አየር ማረፊያውን ለመልቀቅ የሚያስብ ያህል ረጅም ሲሆን ነው።
back_translation: A passenger transiting within the same terminal on a single booking generally does not need a transit visa. A visa is needed when the transit requires leaving the transit zone, when baggage must be reclaimed and registered again, or when the layover is long enough that you intend to leave the airport.

english: When a transit passenger needs a visa, and when they do not.
amharic: የመሸጋገሪያ ተሳፋሪ ቪዛ የሚያስፈልገው መቼ እንደሆነ፣ እና የማያስፈልገው መቼ እንደሆነ።
back_translation: When a transit passenger needs a visa, and when one is not needed.
Transit and visas
Waitlist (=)

english: A waitlist holds you for a fare class that is sold out on a flight you have already booked. It clears in the order requests were received, and it clears automatically -- you are emailed and the booking updates itself. Waitlists close 24 hours before departure.
amharic: የመጠባበቂያ ዝርዝር አስቀድመው በያዙት በረራ ላይ ለተሸጠ የታሪፍ ክፍል ይይዝዎታል። ጥያቄዎች በደረሱበት ቅደም ተከተል ይጸዳል፤ በራሱም ይጸዳል -- በኢሜይል ይነገርዎታል፤ የቦታ ማስያዣውም ራሱን ያዘምናል። የመጠባበቂያ ዝርዝሮች ከመነሻው 24 ሰዓት በፊት ይዘጋሉ።
back_translation: A waiting list holds you for a fare class that is sold out on a flight you have already booked. It clears in the order the requests arrived, and it clears by itself -- you are told by email and the booking updates itself. Waiting lists close 24 hours before departure.
Standby (=)

english: Standby moves you to an earlier or later flight on the same day, at the airport, if a seat is free at the gate. It is not a waitlist and it is not free: same-day standby carries a flat charge, and it opens 24 hours before departure.
amharic: ተጠባባቂ በበሩ ላይ መቀመጫ ካለ በአየር ማረፊያ በተመሳሳይ ቀን ወደ ቀደመ ወይም ወደ ዘገየ በረራ ያዛውርዎታል። የመጠባበቂያ ዝርዝር አይደለም፤ ነጻም አይደለም፦ የዕለቱ ተጠባባቂ ቋሚ ክፍያ አለው፤ ከመነሻውም 24 ሰዓት በፊት ይከፈታል።
back_translation: Standby moves you at the airport to an earlier or later flight on the same day if there is a seat at the gate. It is not a waiting list and it is not free: the day's standby has a fixed charge, and it opens 24 hours before departure.

english: How a waitlist clears, and how standby differs from it.
amharic: የመጠባበቂያ ዝርዝር እንዴት እንደሚጸዳ፣ እንዲሁም ተጠባባቂ ከእሱ በምን እንደሚለይ።
back_translation: How a waitlist clears, and how standby differs from it. (=)
Waitlists and standby (=)
Within our control (=)

english: A technical fault, crew shortage or scheduling decision. We rebook you at no charge on the next available service, provide meals for a delay over 2 hours, and a hotel with transfers when an overnight stay is unavoidable.
amharic: የቴክኒክ ብልሽት፣ የሠራተኛ እጥረት ወይም የመርሐ ግብር ውሳኔ። ያለክፍያ በሚቀጥለው በሚገኝ በረራ እንደግምዎታለን፤ ከ2 ሰዓት በላይ ለሚዘገይ ምግብ እናቀርባለን፤ ማደር የግድ ሲሆንም ከትራንስፖርት ጋር ሆቴል እናዘጋጃለን።
back_translation: A technical fault, crew shortage or scheduling decision. We rebook you at no charge on the next available service, provide meals for a delay over 2 hours, and a hotel with transfers when an overnight stay is unavoidable. (=)
Outside our control (=)

english: Weather, volcanic ash, air traffic restrictions, airport closure, strike action by third parties, and security instructions from an authority. We still rebook you at no charge, and a refund remains available if you no longer wish to travel, but meals and accommodation are not provided.
amharic: የአየር ሁኔታ፣ የእሳተ ገሞራ አመድ፣ የአየር ትራፊክ ገደቦች፣ የአየር ማረፊያ መዘጋት፣ በሦስተኛ ወገኖች የሚደረግ የሥራ ማቆም አድማ፣ እንዲሁም ከባለሥልጣን የሚሰጡ የደህንነት መመሪያዎች። አሁንም ያለክፍያ እንደግምዎታለን፤ መጓዝ ካልፈለጉም ተመላሽ ክፍያ ይገኛል፤ ነገር ግን ምግብና ማረፊያ አይቀርብም።
back_translation: Weather, volcanic ash, air traffic restrictions, airport closure, strike action by third parties, and security instructions from an authority. We still rebook you at no charge, and a refund remains available if you no longer wish to travel, but meals and accommodation are not provided. (=)
Either way (=)

english: Your checked bags travel on whichever flight you end up on, and a connection missed because of our delay is rebooked without a change fee.
amharic: የተመዘገቡ ሻንጣዎችዎ በመጨረሻ በሚሳፈሩበት በረራ ይጓዛሉ፤ በእኛ መዘግየት ምክንያት ያመለጠ መሸጋገሪያም ያለ የለውጥ ክፍያ ይደገማል።
back_translation: Your checked bags travel on whichever flight you end up on, and a connection missed because of our delay is rebooked without a change fee. (=)

english: What we owe you when a flight is disrupted, and what we do not.
back_translation: What we owe you when a flight is disrupted, and what we do not. (=)

Power

english: Boeing 787-8 and Airbus A350-900 aircraft have a universal socket at every seat and USB at every seat. Boeing 737-800 and A320neo have USB only. Dash 8-400 and Embraer 175 have neither.
amharic: የቦይንግ 787-8 እና የኤርባስ A350-900 አውሮፕላኖች በእያንዳንዱ መቀመጫ ሁለንተናዊ ሶኬትና USB አላቸው። ቦይንግ 737-800 እና A320neo USB ብቻ አላቸው። ዳሽ 8-400 እና ኤምብራየር 175 ሁለቱም የላቸውም።
back_translation: Boeing 787-8 and Airbus A350-900 aircraft have a universal socket and USB at every seat. Boeing 737-800 and A320neo have USB only. Dash 8-400 and Embraer 175 have neither.

english: Connectivity is available only on Wi-Fi-equipped aircraft. Whether your own flight is equipped is shown on the flight status page for that flight.
amharic: ግንኙነት የሚገኘው ዋይ-ፋይ ባላቸው አውሮፕላኖች ላይ ብቻ ነው። የራስዎ በረራ የተገጠመለት መሆኑ ለዚያ በረራ በበረራ ሁኔታ ገጽ ላይ ይታያል።
back_translation: Connectivity is available only on aircraft that have Wi-Fi. Whether your own flight is equipped is shown for that flight on the flight status page.

english: Which aircraft have sockets, and how connectivity differs by type.
amharic: የትኞቹ አውሮፕላኖች ሶኬት እንዳላቸው፣ እና ግንኙነት በዓይነት እንዴት እንደሚለያይ።
back_translation: Which aircraft have sockets, and how connectivity differs by type.

back_translation: A room past the security check where four people sleep, with two bathrooms.

amharic: በተርሚናሉ የሕዝብ በኩል ያለ ነጠላ ክፍል። በኢሚግሬሽን ስለሚያልፉ ቪዛ ያስፈልጋል።
back_translation: A single room on the public side of the terminal. A visa is needed, because you pass through immigration.

back_translation: A suite with a separate rest area and meal service.

amharic: ሲሊንደሮች ባዶ መሆንና ቫልቫቸው ተነስቶ ወይም ለምርመራ ክፍት መሆን አለበት።
back_translation: Cylinders must be empty and their valve removed or open for inspection.
Fish-catching equipment [English says 'Fishing gear']

english: Rods in a hard tube. Hooks must be covered and stowed in the tackle box.
amharic: ዘንጎቹ በጠንካራ ቱቦ ውስጥ። መንጠቆዎቹ ተሸፍነው በመሣሪያ ሳጥን ውስጥ መቀመጥ አለባቸው።
back_translation: The rods in a hard tube. The hooks must be covered and placed in the tackle box.
Archery equipment [lit: 'arrow equipment']

english: Bow and arrows in a hard case. Not accepted as cabin baggage.
amharic: ቀስቱና ፍላጻዎቹ በጠንካራ ሳጥን ውስጥ። እንደ የእጅ ሻንጣ አይቀበልም።
back_translation: The bow and arrows in a hard case. Not accepted as cabin baggage.
Bowling ball [transliterated]

english: One ball per passenger, in a fitted bag.
amharic: በአንድ ተሳፋሪ አንድ ኳስ፣ በሚመጥን ከረጢት ውስጥ።
back_translation: One ball per passenger, in a fitting bag.
Pole vault poles [the discipline is transliterated]

english: Length over 300 cm requires cargo carriage on a separate air waybill.
amharic: ከ300 ሴሜ በላይ ርዝመት በተለየ የአየር ማጓጓዣ ሰነድ የጭነት ማጓጓዝ ይፈልጋል።
back_translation: A length over 300 cm needs cargo carriage on a separate air waybill.
Hang-glider [lit: 'hanging floater']

english: Wide-body aircraft only, and subject to space on the day.
amharic: በሰፊ አካል አውሮፕላኖች ብቻ፣ እንዲሁም በዕለቱ ባለው ቦታ ልክ።
back_translation: Wide-body aircraft only, and according to the space available on the day.
Parachute [transliterated]

english: Packed rig only. The reserve must be within its repack date.
amharic: የታሸገ መሣሪያ ብቻ። ተጠባባቂው በእንደገና ማሸጊያ ቀኑ ውስጥ መሆን አለበት።
back_translation: A packed rig only. The reserve must be within its repack date.
Violin or viola [transliterated]

english: Fits the cabin bag size and travels as your cabin bag at no charge.
amharic: የእጅ ሻንጣ መጠንን ስለሚያሟላ እንደ የእጅ ሻንጣዎ ያለክፍያ ይጓዛል።
back_translation: It meets the cabin bag size, so it travels as your cabin bag without a charge.
Guitar [transliterated]

english: Too large for the cabin. Hard case required in the hold.
amharic: ለካቢን በጣም ትልቅ ነው። በጭነት ክፍል ጠንካራ ሳጥን ያስፈልጋል።
back_translation: It is too large for the cabin. A hard case is required in the hold.
Cello [transliterated]

english: Travels on a seat bought for it at the adult fare. Booked 72 hours ahead.
amharic: ለእሱ በተገዛ መቀመጫ በአዋቂ ታሪፍ ይጓዛል። ከ72 ሰዓት በፊት ይያዛል።
back_translation: It travels on a seat bought for it, at the adult fare. It is booked 72 hours ahead.
Bicycle with two seats [English says 'Tandem bicycle']

english: Carried only on wide-body aircraft. Confirm the aircraft type before booking.
amharic: የሚወሰደው በሰፊ አካል አውሮፕላኖች ብቻ ነው። ከመያዝዎ በፊት የአውሮፕላኑን ዓይነት ያረጋግጡ።
back_translation: It is carried on wide-body aircraft only. Confirm the aircraft type before you book.
Double bass (=)

english: Hold only, in a hard flight case. Not accepted in a soft cover.
amharic: በጭነት ክፍል ብቻ፣ በጠንካራ የበረራ ሳጥን ውስጥ። በለስላሳ ሽፋን አይቀበልም።
back_translation: In the hold only, in a hard flight case. Not accepted in a soft cover.
Brass instrument (=)

english: Hard case required. Valves must be secured.
amharic: ጠንካራ ሳጥን ያስፈልጋል። ቫልቮቹ መታሰር አለባቸው።
back_translation: A hard case is required. The valves must be secured.
Drum set [English says 'Drum kit']

english: Carried as two pieces. Cymbals must be in a separate padded bag.
amharic: እንደ ሁለት ዕቃ ይወሰዳል። ሲምባሎቹ በተለየ የተለሰለሰ ከረጢት ውስጥ መሆን አለባቸው።
back_translation: It is carried as two pieces. The cymbals must be in a separate padded bag.
Keyboard [transliterated]

english: Hard case or flight case. Stands travel separately.
amharic: ጠንካራ ሳጥን ወይም የበረራ ሳጥን። መቆሚያዎቹ በተለየ ይጓዛሉ።
back_translation: A hard case or a flight case. The stands travel separately.
Harp [rendered with begena, the Ethiopian lyre]

english: Wide-body aircraft only. Two-week notice and a signed damage waiver.
amharic: በሰፊ አካል አውሮፕላኖች ብቻ። የሁለት ሳምንት ማሳወቂያና የተፈረመ የጉዳት ማስተባበያ።
back_translation: Wide-body aircraft only. Two weeks' notice and a signed damage waiver.
Folding wheelchair (=)

english: Carried free and does not count against your allowance.
back_translation: It is carried free and is not deducted from your allowance.
Powered wheelchair (=)

english: Free, but the battery type must be declared 48 hours ahead.
amharic: በነጻ ነው፤ ነገር ግን የባትሪው ዓይነት ከ48 ሰዓት በፊት መገለጽ አለበት።
back_translation: It is free, but the battery type must be declared 48 hours ahead.
Mobility scooter [scooter transliterated]

english: Free. Lithium batteries above 300 Wh must be removed and carried in the cabin.
amharic: በነጻ። ከ300 ዋት-ሰዓት በላይ የሆኑ የሊቲየም ባትሪዎች ተነስተው በካቢን መያዝ አለባቸው።
back_translation: Free. Lithium batteries above 300 watt-hours must be removed and carried in the cabin.
Portable oxygen concentrator (=)

english: Free. Bring enough battery for 150% of the flight time and a medical letter.
amharic: በነጻ። ለበረራው ጊዜ 150% የሚበቃ ባትሪና የሕክምና ደብዳቤ ይዘው ይምጡ።
back_translation: Free. Bring a battery sufficient for 150% of the flight time, and a medical letter.
CPAP machine [transliterated]

english: Free and additional to your cabin allowance. Distilled water is not supplied.
amharic: በነጻ ነው፤ ከእጅ ሻንጣ ፈቃድዎም በተጨማሪ። የተጣራ ውሃ አይቀርብም።
back_translation: It is free, and additional to your cabin allowance. Distilled water is not supplied.
Golf bag (=)

english: One bag holds clubs, balls and a pair of shoes. Counts as one checked piece.
amharic: አንድ ከረጢት ዱላዎችን፣ ኳሶችንና አንድ ጥንድ ጫማ ይይዛል። እንደ አንድ የተመዘገበ ዕቃ ይቆጠራል።
back_translation: One bag holds clubs, balls and a pair of shoes. It counts as one checked piece.
Stretcher [lit: 'bed-bier']

english: Arranged through the medical desk only, at six economy fares. Not bookable online.
amharic: የሚዘጋጀው በሕክምና ክፍል ብቻ ነው፤ በስድስት የኢኮኖሚ ታሪፍ። በመስመር ላይ አይያዝም።
back_translation: It is arranged through the medical desk only, at six economy fares. It is not booked online.
Child's pushchair [English says 'Pushchair or pram'; Amharic has one word]

english: Free for a passenger travelling with a child. Taken at the aircraft door.
amharic: ከልጅ ጋር ለሚጓዝ ተሳፋሪ በነጻ። በአውሮፕላኑ በር ላይ ይወሰዳል።
back_translation: Free for a passenger travelling with a child. It is taken at the aircraft door.
Car child seat (=)

english: Free when a child is on the booking. Otherwise charged as an extra piece.
amharic: በቦታ ማስያዣው ላይ ልጅ ሲኖር በነጻ። ካልሆነ እንደ ተጨማሪ ዕቃ ይከፈላል።
back_translation: Free when there is a child on the booking. Otherwise it is charged as an extra piece.
Television or monitor [lit: 'display']

english: Original packaging or a wooden crate. Screens above 165 cm go as cargo.
amharic: የመጀመሪያው ማሸጊያ ወይም የእንጨት ሳጥን። ከ165 ሴሜ በላይ ማሳያዎች እንደ ጭነት ይሄዳሉ።
back_translation: The original packaging or a wooden crate. Displays above 165 cm go as cargo.
Bulky household item [English says 'appliance']

english: Fluids drained and the door taped shut.
back_translation: The fluids drained and the door taped shut.
Artwork set in a frame (=)

english: Glass must be removed or taped. We do not insure glass in the hold.
amharic: መስታወቱ መነሳት ወይም መለጠፍ አለበት። በጭነት ክፍል ላለ መስታወት ዋስትና አንሰጥም።
back_translation: The glass must be removed or taped. We give no guarantee for glass in the hold.
Traditional drum (=)

english: Skin heads loosened for the pressure change, in a padded cover.
amharic: ለግፊት ለውጡ ቆዳዎቹ ላልተው፣ በተለሰለሰ ሽፋን ውስጥ።
back_translation: The skins loosened for the pressure change, in a padded cover.
Sport firearm [lit: 'sport shooting instrument']

english: Permit required, declared at check-in, in a locked hard case.
amharic: ፈቃድ ያስፈልጋል፤ በቼክ-ኢን ጊዜ ይገለጻል፤ በተቆለፈ ጠንካራ ሳጥን ውስጥ።
back_translation: A permit is required; it is declared at check-in; in a locked hard case.
Ammunition [lit: 'bullet']

english: Up to 5 kg per passenger, in the manufacturer's packaging, separate from the firearm.
amharic: በአንድ ተሳፋሪ እስከ 5 ኪግ፣ በአምራቹ ማሸጊያ ውስጥ፣ ከተኩስ መሣሪያው ተለይቶ።
back_translation: Up to 5 kg per passenger, in the manufacturer's packaging, separated from the firearm.
Hoverboard or self-balancing board [hoverboard transliterated]

english: Not accepted in the cabin or the hold, on any route, at any weight.
amharic: በካቢንም ሆነ በጭነት ክፍል፣ በማንኛውም መስመር፣ በማንኛውም ክብደት አይቀበልም።
back_translation: Not accepted in the cabin or the hold, on any route, at any weight.
Ski and boot bag [lit: 'snow-sliding and shoe bag']

english: Skis, poles and one pair of boots together count as one piece.
amharic: መንሸራተቻዎች፣ ዘንጎችና አንድ ጥንድ ጫማ በአንድነት እንደ አንድ ዕቃ ይቆጠራሉ።
back_translation: Skis, poles and one pair of boots together count as one piece.
Smart bag with a fixed battery [smart transliterated]

english: Refused unless the battery can be removed and carried in the cabin.
amharic: ባትሪው ተነስቶ በካቢን መያዝ ካልተቻለ አይቀበልም።
back_translation: It is not accepted unless the battery can be removed and carried in the cabin.
Snowboard [transliterated]

english: In a padded board bag. Loose bindings must be removed.
amharic: በተለሰለሰ የቦርድ ከረጢት ውስጥ። የላሉ ማሰሪያዎች መነሳት አለባቸው።
back_translation: In a padded board bag. Loose bindings must be removed.
Surf board (=)

english: Boards over 300 cm are refused. Fins removed, in a padded board bag.
amharic: ከ300 ሴሜ በላይ የሆኑ ቦርዶች አይቀበሉም። ክንፎቹ ተነስተው በተለሰለሰ የቦርድ ከረጢት ውስጥ።
back_translation: Boards over 300 cm are not accepted. The fins removed, in a padded board bag.
Windsurf equipment (=)

english: Mast, board and sail together. Booked as one special item.
amharic: ምሰሶው፣ ቦርዱና ሸራው በአንድነት። እንደ አንድ ልዩ ዕቃ ይያዛል።
back_translation: The mast, the board and the sail together. It is booked as one special item.
Kitesurf equipment (=)

english: Lines coiled and the bar secured. Pressurised pumps must be empty.
amharic: ገመዶቹ ተጠቅልለው ዘንጉ ታስሮ። ግፊት ያላቸው ፓምፖች ባዶ መሆን አለባቸው።
back_translation: The lines coiled and the bar secured. Pressurised pumps must be empty.
Kayak or canoe (=)

english: Carried only on wide-body aircraft and only up to 300 cm.
amharic: የሚወሰደው በሰፊ አካል አውሮፕላኖች ብቻ እንዲሁም እስከ 300 ሴሜ ብቻ ነው።
back_translation: It is carried on wide-body aircraft only, and only up to 300 cm.

amharic: በቅመም የተዘጋጀ የሕንድ ዓይነት የቬጀቴሪያን ምግብ።
back_translation: An Indian-style vegetarian meal prepared with spices.
Asian vegetarian [vegetarian transliterated]

english: Jarred baby food for infants under two.
amharic: ከሁለት ዓመት በታች ለሆኑ ጨቅላዎች በማሰሮ የታሸገ ምግብ።
back_translation: Food packed in a jar, for infants under two.
For infants (=)

english: Smaller portions for children aged 2 to 11.
amharic: ከ2 እስከ 11 ዓመት ለሆኑ ሕፃናት አነስተኛ መጠን።
back_translation: Smaller portions for children aged 2 to 11.
For children (=)

amharic: ቁጥጥር የተደረገበት ካርቦሃይድሬት፣ የተጨመረ ስኳር የለም።
back_translation: Carbohydrate is controlled; there is no added sugar.
For a diabetic person [English says 'Diabetic']
Fresh seasonal fruit only.
Fruit plate [English says 'Fruit platter']

english: No wheat, rye, barley or oats. Prepared to a dietary specification; it is not an allergy control.
amharic: ስንዴ፣ ራይ፣ ገብስ ወይም አጃ የለም። በአመጋገብ መስፈርት ይዘጋጃል፤ የአለርጂ ቁጥጥር አይደለም።
back_translation: No wheat, rye, barley or oats. It is prepared to a dietary specification; it is not an allergy control. [rye is transliterated -- Amharic has no settled word for it]
note: changed since review; was: ስንዴ፣ ሩዝ፣ ገብስ ወይም አጃ የለም። በአመጋገብ መስፈርት ይዘጋጃል፤ የአለርጂ ቁጥጥር አይደለ

back_translation: The one gluten does not agree with [English says 'Gluten intolerant']

english: Non-vegetarian Indian meal without beef or pork.
amharic: የበሬና የአሳማ ሥጋ የሌለው የሕንድ ምግብ።
back_translation: An Indian meal without beef or pork.
Hindu [transliterated]

english: Sealed kosher meal, loaded from an external supplier.
amharic: ከውጭ አቅራቢ የሚጫን የታሸገ የኮሸር ምግብ።

back_translation: No meat, fish, eggs, dairy products or root vegetables.
Jain vegetarian [transliterated]

amharic: በመሸጋገሪያ ቀጠናው ውስጥ ያለ ክፍል። በኢሚግሬሽን ስለማያልፉ ቪዛ አያስፈልግም።
back_translation: A room inside the transit zone. No visa is needed because you do not pass through immigration.
Zena Transit Hotel, inside the terminal [transliterated brand]

amharic: በመሃል አዲስ አበባ ያለ ክፍል። አየር ማረፊያውን ስለሚለቁ ቪዛ ያስፈልጋል።
back_translation: A room in central Addis Ababa. A visa is needed, since you leave the airport.
City hotel, four star (=)

english: Shared coach between the airport and your city hotel, timed to your flights.
amharic: በአየር ማረፊያውና በከተማ ሆቴልዎ መካከል ከበረራዎ ጋር የተቀናጀ የጋራ አውቶቡስ።
back_translation: A shared coach between the airport and your city hotel, timed to your flights.
Airport transport, there and back [English says 'transfer, both ways']

english: Lounge access for the duration of the connection, including showers.
amharic: ሻወርን ጨምሮ ለመሸጋገሪያው ጊዜ ሙሉ የላውንጅ መግቢያ።
back_translation: Full lounge entry for the length of the connection, including showers.
Highland Lounge entry [transliterated brand]

english: Guided visit to the National Museum and Merkato, with hotel pick-up.
amharic: ከሆቴል መውሰድን ጨምሮ ወደ ብሔራዊ ሙዚየምና መርካቶ የሚደረግ የተመራ ጉብኝት።
back_translation: A guided visit to the National Museum and Merkato, including hotel pick-up.
Half-day city tour (=)

english: Day trip to the Entoto highlands and Debre Libanos, returning by evening.
amharic: ወደ እንጦጦ ደጋና ደብረ ሊባኖስ የሚደረግ የቀን ጉዞ፣ ምሽት ተመላሽ።

Full-day highlands trip (=)

amharic: አልጋ፣ ሻወርና የምግብ አገልግሎት ያለው የግል ስዊት።
back_translation: A private suite with a bed, a shower and meal service.
Highland Class arrivals suite [transliterated brand]

back_translation: Without a visa for 90 days for many nationalities

back_translation: A passport valid for six months beyond arrival; a recent passport photograph; a confirmed return ticket; proof of accommodation.

amharic: ለበዓልና ለቤተሰብ ጉብኝት። ለክፍያ ሥራ ወይም ለትምህርት አይሠራም።
back_translation: For holidays and family visits. It does not work for paid work or for study.

amharic: እንደ 30 ቀኑ ቪዛ፣ በተጨማሪም ያለፉትን ሦስት ወራት የሚሸፍን የባንክ መግለጫ።
back_translation: As for the 30-day visa, and in addition a bank statement covering the last three months.

english: Longer holiday stays. Single entry only.
amharic: ረዘም ያለ የበዓል ቆይታ። አንድ ጊዜ መግቢያ ብቻ።
back_translation: Longer holiday stays. Single entry only.
Tourist e-Visa, 90 days (=)

back_translation: A passport; the onward ticket; the booking reference of the connecting flight.

amharic: እስከ 72 ሰዓት በሚደርስ መሸጋገሪያ ወቅት አየር ማረፊያውን ለሚለቁ ተሳፋሪዎች።
back_translation: For passengers who leave the airport during a connection of up to 72 hours.
Transit e-Visa (=)

amharic: መሰረዝ መቀመጫዎችዎን ወዲያውኑ ይለቃል። ገንዘብ ይመለስ አይመለስ በተመላሽ ክፍያ ገጽ ላይ ባሉት የታሪፍ ደንቦች ይወሰናል። አስቀድመው ከሰረዙ ምንም ላያገኙ ይችላሉ።
back_translation: Cancelling releases your seats immediately. Whether money is returned or not is decided by the fare rules on the refund page. If you cancel first you may get nothing.

amharic: መሰረዝ ከተመላሽ ክፍያ ጋር አንድ አይደለም
back_translation: Cancelling is not the same as a refund

back_translation: Perishable goods, if packed with coolant and booked at least 48 hours in advance.

amharic: ደረቅ በረዶ፣ በአንድ ጭነት እስከ 200 ኪግ፣ በማጓጓዣ ሰነዱ ላይ ተገልጾ።
back_translation: Dry ice, up to 200 kg per shipment, declared on the waybill.

amharic: ነዳጅ የያዘ ማሽነሪ፣ ከተራገፈና ታንኩ ክፍት ከተተወ።
back_translation: Machinery containing fuel, if drained and the tank left open.

amharic: እነዚህ ገደቦች ከተሳፋሪ ሻንጣ ገደቦች የተለዩ ናቸው። አንዱን በሌላው ቦታ አያንብቡ።
back_translation: These limits are different from the passenger baggage limits. Do not read one in place of the other.

back_translation: We carry freight in the cargo hold of scheduled passenger flights. The prices are indicative; the final rate is confirmed by the cargo office.

back_translation: Explosives, fireworks and ammunition of any kind.

back_translation: Unfitted lithium batteries sent on their own.

back_translation: Live animals other than through the animal transport desk.

amharic: መስመሩን፣ ክብደቱንና ልኬቱን ይስጡን፤ አመላካች ተመን እንመልሳለን።
back_translation: Give us the route, the weight and the dimensions and we return an indicative rate.

amharic: እነዚህ ደንቦች በጭነት ክፍል ውስጥ ላለ ጭነት ይሠራሉ። እንደ ተሳፋሪ የሚይዙት ሻንጣ ግን ተመሳሳይ ያልሆኑትን የሻንጣ ደንቦች ይከተላል።
back_translation: These rules apply to freight in the hold. Baggage you carry as a passenger follows the baggage rules instead, which are not the same.

back_translation: City museums and heritage places; most are reached from the city centre by a short taxi ride.

back_translation: There is no posted entry rule for this country.

back_translation: Parks, viewpoints and half-day excursions that fit within a long connection.
